text: I like the game. I like redoing the house and garden, however I wish they had maybe 5 different game options for earning stars, energy, and coins, that way when you get stuck or frustrated with one you can earn power ups and stuff from the other games. you could also have different levels, such as relaxed mode, where there are no limited number of moves. And challenge mode, which would be like it is now.

The ads for this game are, of course, 100% misrepresentation. You don't get to pick each puzzle level or choose items to help a mother, child & baby rebuild their life, etc. It's a basic matching puzzle game, with a predetermined backstory about a butler and his family & friends rehab various abandoned buildings & yards. Very occasionally, you get to choose one of three chairs, rugs, wallpaper, or whatever. If you're OK with that, go ahead and install it.

Horrible, greedy, no fun, pay to play game. This game is ridiculous. You can't win the super hard levels, which are about every third game, unless you buy coins or collect them to buy more moves. If you like playing a level 50 plus times without winning then this is the game for you. Being forced to buy coins and boosters every 3 games pretty much guarantees I won't so they are actually shooting themselves in the foot.

Fun game and very entertaining. I am not a big fan, however, of the game's algorithm. Tailoring how pieces fall out on certain levels that puts players in a box to lose lives and/or use power ups is annoying. After losing a level multiple times, especially when on a free infinite lives gift, spending some power ups magically works in the players favor to finish the level. I understand that making everyone a winner isn't a game, but frustrations like I'm experiencing make me not want to play.

Had this game for years on two different accounts. Was pretty good at first as a standard play and decorate game. Everytime I open this app now, I'm bombarded with like 10 different events and a new same storyline that goes nowhere that I don't care for. Other than that the levels itself are fine. Some are pretty hard and occasionally require power ups but they aren't that hard to get. Overall, pretty solid but could go without the expeditions I doubt anyone cares for.

While I enjoy a challenging game, this one has become ridiculous. Levels have become too difficult to pass, taking too many boasters and free time. Would not recommend this game as none of the issues have been resolved despite many stating the same issues. The frustration level is to the point of wanting to give a negative rating if it was possible.

took a break from it, and came back to beginner levels that almost require you to use power-ups or coins to be able to pull through. As soon as level 7 or so hit, suddenly I couldnt complete a level without using upgrades or buying more moves, and even then it wasnt guaranteed and I end up wasting time and money. the level scaling seems to have simply broke

I enjoy playing the game, but for some reason, in this game and Family Island, the top .5 inch of the screen doesn't work. I don't have this issue in any other games or on my phone in general. But it makes some of the puzzles unplayable. Flipping my phone over to the other side also doesn't fix it. It's really frustrating, so I'm just going to uninstall.

this used to be my favorite game but it barely deserves 2 stars now. it's incredibly difficult and when you need support it's a bot. it seems impossible impossible to get a real person. I had unlimited lives for 30 minutes and yet it was still subtracting lives when I lost a level. it's never done that. I couldn't get any help. I'm incredibly disappointed.

it's ok. it's not a game I would play on its own. I got this game to earn gems for my Disney Kingdoms game. But reviewing the game by itself, decorating is pretty fun. I like that aspect. But the characters are kinda boring to me? so having quests like "greet this character, make this phone call, etc" isn't too fun, especially when it costs stars that you have to earn from beating levels.

It's definitely a money-grab game. Most of the boards will cost you money to even pass. I purchased a package before for 20k coins and spent it within a few days, bc you pay 900 or more to keep playing to pass it, while the reward for passing it is only 35 or 100 coins. Not worth it! I refuse to make any other purchases. Eventually, what will happen is I will get bored with being stuck on the same board again and just quit playing altogether. 🤷‍♀️

I enjoy this game. Currently level 5500+. I feel like they have made the game with more hard and super hard levels though. Don't mind working through hard levels, but when it feels like its a hard push to make you spend money, it makes me not want to play. Adding some difficulty, fine, but this feels over the line. Hard, super hard, and now ultra hard levels? With a few easy levels sprinkled in. And no added bonuses. Come on now. Not even the 3 star levels anymore. Forget me spending $ again.

I've been playing since 2018. Cons - I don't like the update to the power ups, took away the best one (double airplanes) and split up the bomb & rocket so instead of both you only get one. Side games are boring now, always the same thing with a different story, earn energy points to spend. I miss the make overs and merge side games and wish they'd bring back the special holiday decorations that you could earn WITHOUT spending $. Also miss ads for coins. Pros - never spent any $ to beat a level.

I love this game, it is so fun but very irritating. Because you can purchase game packs the developers have set the game up so that moving between the levels is at times extremely hard if you are not making a purchase. Also it would be nice if you earned more than one star for certain levels so that you can finish more projects on Austin's family mansion.

I used to like this game. I started playing it as a way to spend time with my spouse. They have made even the "easy" levels after you reach 1,000 impossibly difficult. This is not a game of skill, but sheer dumb luck. And if you do get power ups, this game gives you the worst luck to immediately fail the level and lose all your power ups. This game no longer brings joy. Edit: This game made me cry in frustration. Don't download. This game only gets worse. Don't lose or you are screwed.

Games like this always start really fun and enjoyable. The puzzles are fun, the story is cute, creating and decorating the different rooms is delightful and cute. HOWEVER eventually it takes days to pass the super hard puzzles. you've run out of all of your power ups and it's nearly impossible to pass levels without them. They clearly do this to try to frustrate you into spending money. It's annoying and disgusting. I'd rather just pay $5 to forever just play and enjoy a game up front.

There aren't any ads like the game states, but many levels are difficult and you can get stuck on them for a few days unless your willing to spend money. They don't give you enough moves to get through the level and if you refuse to purchase anything after about 25 tries they make it easy to pass. I don't have the patience for this type of game.

Update, I gave the game another chance. I was mid game when the app crashed, and erased my win streak. also causing me to lose some in game advantages. Support was dismissive. THESE ADMINS ARE CROOKS!!! Lately, game won't save my progress and I go several hours without playing and I don't have any lives when I come back.

Very fun, great story lines... Updated 7/2/2026 Unable to use or play, stuck on one scene in the main storyline. Unable to progress past and will not allow me to play any portion of the game. Emailed playtrix with no response in a week. Long running game has had its ups and downs but this is different. Hope the dev team is watching these and responds as I do enjoy playing.

I was saving up energy to play the quest games and now every time they have a new quest they decrease your energy back to 100. I had like 2500 saved up energy for the quest games and y'all squashed that. Also after level 400 the matching games become quite irritating and I've had to play levels upwards of 15 times to win and move on to the next puzzle. This game becomes less fun and more annoying the more you play it.

It's fun until you reach match 3 levels that are impossible to beat. That's when getting you to spend $ to keep playing happens. No thank you. I gave 3☆ because the premise is really fun, but once you hit that point where the algorithm thinks you should be paying $, the fun is gone.

Edited: avoid this game, it holds you back on purpose. The items in game purposely miss targets or attack the same target in the end match. I've had power ups disappear mid use. The algorithm actually keep you from passing too manly levels to keep you from speeding through the mini games.it actually cheating you as you play. They stick you on easy levels to make sure you lose any power ups as well. This came cheats to frustration and forces people to be a cash grab bs pay to win game. Hate it.

Been playing since 2021 and max level. New updates terrible! Its been going downhill a while and this most recent one messed up boosters, but only for some players on the team, not all! They are going too far to push for purchases, especially during Olympus cup mode which is just the same old difficult levels over and over. Gold coin rewards are miniscule now.

Example: You get exactly 15 moves to clear two whole boards, and it takes at least 13 to clear just the first board. For one board to take ovet 100 tries to clear it, it's not worth it! I recommend Strongblade as a much more satisfying match 3 game. If I could give THIS game no stars instead of one just to leave a review, I absolutely would! This game would be fun if they'd just give you enough moves per board. Defintely a pay to advance game. Big Nope for me!

It's a great game to play when you have some time to kill. game saves exactly where you left off, even in the middle of a game, when you close the app completely, for days lol. I'm not joking, it's actually impressive. I also enjoy no pop-ups. it's a great game to play, and it does evolve nicely. I'm in the very high levels now lol so I'm worried I will hit a house completion.. we shall see. My favorite game.

some levels are impossible to win without spending money. it's not challenging. it's meant to keep you from winning the level without money being spent. no one wants to be stuck on one board for weeks. it makes you want to smash your phone 😞. I'm getting tired of it... and if I wanted the extra boosts I'd get them, instead of accidentally spending EVERY COIN,!!

I have loved playing this game, especially the decorating aspect of it. However, some levels are incredibly hard and you are not given many moves to complete it, for example, I was given 10 moves to clear 35 soap squares (?) which is absolutely ridiculous. Although it is a nice game to play, if you don't spend money on it, it can be impossible to complete some levels and therefore you cannot move on and complete more tasks. Overall, a bit of a money grab but an enjoyable game.

It's ok. The puzzles get extremely frustrating and unsolvable without bought extras, unless you like doing the same puzzle 500 times in the chance you get lucky with a combo. The only thing that kept me playing this and the garden game was the decorating. I wish they'd just make a "game" with more decorating! I'm about to quit though as the game party isn't fun anymore. 1/31/26 revisited: the bridge game math ain't mathing. 7 winners but the loot divided by 10? I hate games that cheat.

at a certain level they require you to use power ups/play ons. I feel like it will decide whether or not you win the game. I've noticed after ive used the limited power-ups, play ons, or sometimes just leave and come back, it will just start giving me special bits or dropping the bits/colors in a way where they match themselves and you collect multiple things. (im lvl 250, and ive been noticing it for a minute)

I've been playing this game for a long time, if you can count clicking on rocks as playing. That part is absolutely boring and not necessary. Yet this is absolutely necessary to advance through that story line. I have begun to click skip through the story because I'm so bored with that. Now as far as the match 3 levels are concerned, you either can solve the puzzle with ease using your basic knowledge of how the different bomb or target boosters work, or you can't complete the Harder levels

It's a good time killer game. It's really unfortunate that once you make it to other spots on the map that the element of choosing decorations severely decreases. It goes from choosing 90% of decorations to choosing 5% of decorations once you leave the main house area. Isn't being able to decorate the entire idea of playing the match 3 game? I've been playing a long time and now I just don't want to because what's the point now?!

Really love this game. I play it to earn pink diamonds for another game, but it's also fun to just pass time too. I much prefer when I use stars that I can CHOOSE out of the three options. I hate when I use stars and it doesn't let me pick. Also, I'm currently at level 730, and its gotten extremely hard. Some levels take days to complete. It's ridiculous when I have to play the same level over and over again and still don't have nearly even close enough to enough moves. Gets frustrating, not fun

FIX THE AI !!!! This game would be great if it weren't so stupid. One box left to finish the board, two moves to open and then destroy it, a rocket which will set off 4 power ups, so it's a guaranteed win right? Nope. One power up goes to the box, the others just landed on pointless areas of the board, pay coins to continue or lose. This happens so many times it's beyond frustrating.

The game is fun and addictive to a point... It is advertised as being free to play with gameplay as advertised without a paywall which is not entirely true. At a certain point, gameplay becomes nearly impossible unless you pay for extra lives/gems/in game currency or repeat the same level over and over until you maybe luck into the correct pattern to finish. I guess the idea is to frustrate players into paying.

Last year was a 5. They took so much out of the game that made it fun that now I'm considering deleting it. I've been playing it for over 5 years and the levels got so hard even in easy levels. Took out a fun side game, took away how many stars you get after completing the level, took away the airplane for a while then put it back in. Increased the number of stars you need to complete tasks to build. Just not fun anymore.

im on level 7000+, it was a fun game until I made the mistake of spending a little $. All the sudden the levels become a lot harder and the greed becomes very apparent. It will constantly put u in the position of just one more move to beat a level, but you have no more moves, pushing you to buy coins to get that last move. It would happen every so often,now it's damn near every single level bc it thinks I'll spend money. I get that making money is the point, but it's gotten egregious

Game said it required updating, but link didn't take me to where I could do that. When I finally found it wouldn't update for more than a month until I gave up. I'm here 9 months later, and at least it's trying to update now. Glitches like this, or getting stuck in a bug are sadly common. Abandoning the game for a while until things are fixed is the only way, as support takes hours to days to answer, & closes your report in under 2 days, even if they took longer than that to respond initially

The updates keep the game interesting. It lost 2 stars for me because the game has become a HUGE money pit. You can't pass levels, get past events or get specials without spending money. Everyone on my team is complaining of quitting the game because of how bad it has gotten. I play but I'm about to block my account so I don't get charged anymore.

As I leveled up in the game it takes more and more to win a level. I'd get a hard level then 1 or 2 normal levels then a super hard level. The daily spin is a joke. in 10 years I hit the jackpot daily DAILY spin twice.... in 10 years. Seems they make it impossible to win unless you purchase boosters. Also if I have an issue and had to uninstall/reinstall the game it would take over an hour to load and it is not my internet. I tested it on other games I have and they loaded in minutes

Okay for the first 350 or so levels, but now they are becoming nearly impossible without powerups and extra lives (PAY TO PLAY). Its extremely frustrating and the game is making me majorly lose interest. In addition, you have to play an obscene about of levels to earn keys. Im about 80 away from the last section for the Easter event and im out of lives... so that was $10 wasted... luckily I had a giftcard.

I really enjoy the game and have played this and Gardenscapes for several years and previously rated them 5 stars. I would leave it that way, but I'm really frustrated and disappointed seeing the current ads for these games which have nothing to do with what these games actually are. If I didn't enjoy the actual gameplay as much as I do I would delete them on principle for the ads that are trying to deceive people about the games. 😕

they have made this more fun with the addition of being able to collect cards and various events, but incredibly frustrating that the expedition is limited when you are finished and you can't do anything with your extra lightning bolts and they just go to waste. it's almost like they are punishing players who play more! please change this as soon as possible and I will change this review!

it's fun overall, but rigged to not let you move past levels without having to make a purchase. And sometimes it'll let you clear everything on the board except one piece, that has happened several times. some rounds the arrows/bombs does alot of damage and in other rounds they barely do any damage. It frustrating at times because you need 900 coins to get only 5 moves to continue without purchase, but it can take weeks to even earn that amount in the game. should be more ways to earn

I have changed my review to 1 star, from 5 stars due to the game malfunctioning despite uninstalling and reinstalling it multiple times. I've also rebooted my phone to no avail. I tried installing it on my laptop and the same problem happened there. I'm very frustrated, as I've spent a significant amount of time and money on the game. I would like some help getting this fixed.

I like this game and I don't mind spending some money on it but I'm sitting in limbo waiting for them to add more levels. All the bonus levels are running out of time. if the game is going to stop me from getting the extras then the game should reward the the player with what they would have won if the player would've finished.

As you progress the game gets harder (almost to the point where playing isn't fun) and to continue to advance, they want you to buy passes ($10) and boosters, which cost real money. I don't have that luxury nor do I think it should ever be that difficult. Also, have a well established team, but NO NEW MEMBERS!?! As if my team is hidden. Have tried multiple recruitment ideas, but still (after months) needing 35 members! This is a shame that we're not receiving ANY HELP!

20,000+. That's how many levels I have completed. I've been playing for years. It is one of those games you can bring up when connected to an Internet connection and zone out to. I'm quitting it. I'm tired of the greedy game play the developers started creating. They have changed the model over time from fun add-on's and art you could earn to stupid monthly packages to further the card game and map quests. The coin earn potential is lower and it's all about how much money you spend. Do better.

I've played this game for years without problems. However, after the latest update the expedition side game was inaccessible. From what I can see the link button to the expedition is being covered by the gold coin chest. I reported it to support and was told they were aware of the problem, but it still hasn't been fixed. From chat room comments, a lot of people are having the same problem. I'm deleting the game now u til it's fixed.

I originally gave this game 5 stars, it was fun, the options to win and or purchase were reasonable. now it's impossible to win levels unless you purchase boosters and or coin. an ad even comes up when I hit retry button saying you should purchase this or that booster to help.. also, only win one star per game, need multiple stars for miniscule tasks like dusting, next one is cobwebs, next one is lighting, etc. I won't be paying for this game. fun while it lasted!

This used to be one of my favorite games, but all the new things being added are destroying it, now you took away the avatar I have used since the beginning, not enjoying this game very much anymore, plus levels have become so hard, stuck for days, lather,rinse, repeat.....boring!!!!!! losing another star, recent tournament my team finished in top 5 but received no coins, ugh!!! So wrong. Game has become so hard, they are forcing players to spend money in order to advance in levels.

Been playing this game for years and recently the developers have decided to do everything in their power to make the game worse. Start the year off so wrong by taking away all the power ups...also adjusting the mechanics of the powerups. Paper airplanes used to only hit squares that were needed (heat seeking if you will) now you can have multiple needed squares, and if you trigger multiple planes they will go for the same thing.

I've been playing this game for years and I always found it fun and relaxing. But recently there has been a shift, I'm not sure if it's the level I'm at or an update. But the levels now are so hard and you get so few moves that the only way you can advance is having to pay for coins. One of the main reasons I loved this game we that it wasn't spending dependent. Even others in my game team have expressed similar feelings. Hopefully it's something they can fix to make it fun again.

Playing this game again after almost three years away from it and my word...it's become soulless. All the little animations and the quirks that made it fun even while the player was waiting for the lives to load have been removed. It's very flat and literally everything constantly needs an update. Don't get me started on the constant reminder that you want us to pay money. Also, the new coin system is preposterous. 10 coins?! From 50 coins?! Even the smallest task requires about 3 stars!!

I liked playing homescapes. I've been playing since 2020. I've seen improvements and some not. I gave this 3 stars but now just 1. It's getting harder to win the "hard or super hard levels without boosters and extra coins to buy added moves. I've been stuck on the same level for more than 3 days already. I've been playing consistently but since I don't have extra coins to buy moves, I can't win the level. Also, it sucks that they removed the airplane booster.

Really abysmal game. Installed this to earn currency in a different game I play. I'm not even at level 100 and need to get to about level 3500 to earn my reward. The game becomes hard and doesn't give you enough moves to win the levels without powerups you have to pay for, which was the EXACT same reason I stopped playing Candy Crush years ago. Progressing is IMPOSSIBLE without waiting hours to recharge lives or "energy". Don't waste your time on this game, and play something else.

I’m so disappointed! I worked hard for all the bonuses I had, but suddenly the app froze, and I was forced out without any reason. When I reopened it, all my bonuses were gone, and my progress toward the "Super Rainbow Ball" reset to zero. Hours of effort wasted just like that. This is so frustrating!

Update: 8 days later I am still stuck on the same level because I refuse to pay; my latest review stands: My review of this was originally 2 stars because the game is an obvious cash grab, but after the latest update this game is not worth it at all. They clearly leaned further into the cash grab, introducing more frequent ridiculous levels that require you to either play them over and over and over, or, like they want, pay money to advance. Obviously this company extremely greedy.

Games are good. But when the moves are exhausted, it is too much to pay 900 for just 5 moves. And at times just 1-2 moves are enough to get over with the game. Money gets exhausted very soon. Love the merge mode games. Keep continuing with them please. They are really fun. The hunt expedition that keeps coming up often takes up too many energies in just clearing half a minute thrash. In three turns all 100 energies are exhausted. Bring more of merge mode games. You have stopped them altogether

I genuinely hate the animations and style of the game now. Its cartoony and doesnt match the rest of the game, and its really distracting. I understand updating an animation if it's been a while, but if its not broke dont fix it you'll just cause problems. Based in other comments most people agree. I am genuinely considering deleting the game if this is not fixed

Pay to win if you want to actually enjoy the game. If the game doesn't want you to complete a level, there is nothing you can do other than waste you 5 lives attempting to do it. When you do complete a level you will be rewarded with 15-30 coins. If you are struggling on a level you can 'pay' for extra moves which costs 900 coins. So you essentially burn through your 5 lives and make maybe 120-150 coins and then are stuck while your lives refresh at 30 mins per life to try and fail again.

i used to love this game but the updates keep on getting worse. it always asks for a lot of requirements to fulfill just to finish one level. they keep on focusing on more events but not on the gameplay. i also love to play the games to earn coins but the coins keeps getting smaller and the task keeps getting complicated. i hope the developer would fix this problem.

It was a very good game in the past, and I still enjoy playing it. However, recent updates, such as reducing the win reward to 10 coins for a normal level, have made me wish you would increase the win reward to 50 coins like before and also increase the value of the...The rewards that existed in the past, such as super power in events and monetary rewards, are back. Thank you.

Hello Homescapes Team, I've been playing this game for a long time, but recently it's becoming more frustrating than enjoyable. The Expedition event has been missing twice, even though my game is updated and working properly. Many levels feel too difficult, there are very few moves, and 900 coins for extra moves feels too expensive. The rewards after winning levels also feel too low. Please make the game more balanced and enjoyable for everyone. Thank you.

Good game, but now you have to pay to progress. I'm over level 7000, but I've noticed that when using bonuses, it intentionally doesn't go to where it should when you have one move remaining, trying to get you to buy 900 coins every time. Stop with the Greed! I've spent about £70 in a month, which I think encourages them to keep making me pay.

Gamemakers STILL haven't learnt that it is no fun for players to get stuck on levels for WEEKS, yes WEEKS on end with no way to navigate to another level if they cannot pass said level. It is SO BORING to play the same level FOR WEEKS...WEEKS, think about that, 1 level, over & over, several times a day for WEEKS. No other option! Because the player doesn't have enough coins to purchase extra moves to complete the level & it's simply not possible without extra moves. This game is absolute $h!t

enjoyable at first, but around level 5000 they make the puzzles impossible to finish without using coins to get more turns or using boosters. once those run out, you will need to buy them just to continue on with the game. you can choose not to buy but you will end up spending 20mins or more just to finish a level. it stopped being fun at that point. felt like either you pay up or don't play.

I've played this game for years now, and used to love it, even spending money on the game passes etc. However, I am no longer seeing the side games (in nearly a month) so I am assuming that my chromebook which is not new but works well, isn't receiving game updates. There is no way I am replacing it for one game, so I fear my time in Homescapes is coming to an end. I don't want to play only "part" of a game, and I suspect Playrix will lose other players/customers by not supporting older devices.

Too harsh. Some levels are easy to complete, but some others are really advanced and you only get 5 or 6 tries to clear the board!! unlike other similar games, they give a few more tries to complete otherwise it's almost impossible. Not enough, and how on earth are you meant to clear a board on a flimsy 6 tries? Absolutely not fair and way too harsh to get to the next level. Not sure if I want to keep on going with this game as it's getting ridiculous and off putting 👎

The game is really fun, but there are some problems. There aren’t enough ads to help us get extra chances, and the attempts are too expensive. Because of that, it’s really hard to finish difficult levels if we don’t have enough coins. Also, having only five lives isn’t enough sometimes. If you increase the number of lives and add more ads for extra chances, the game would be much better and more enjoyable.♥️

i used to love this game but now NO! they changed a lot of things about the game i've playing it for more than 5years and i'm on level 6348! the levels becomes unnecessarily hard they no longer put the bouns levels they changed the booasters that comes with the level they make you earn less money each level than before, and the events are extremely hard to achieve, what's going on! i'm so disappointed

The game releases events that accumulate quickly, the levels aren't helpful, and even the money and points we collect by playing levels are very few compared to what's required. I can't collect anything or succeed in difficult levels without spending a lot of money and using power-ups to progress. Even the boosters have changed; the old ones were better. The difficult levels take a month to complete, and events get lost and has very few chances to try; even the easy levels hard too

I've been playing this game for years, but now that I am at the end of it and they come up with new levels every week while waiting for the new levels you enter a tournament, there comes the problem, you play hundreds of levels and you don't get any stars, it's so bad , they keep updating the game but don't change that, it is bad, those stars you can't buy them or anything like that, you get them by playing but in this case playing is useless.

I really enjoy playing Homescapes. The game is fun, relaxing, and the storyline keeps me engaged. The graphics are beautiful, and the puzzles are challenging without being frustrating. Thank you for creating such an entertaining game. I look forward to future updates, new levels, and exciting features! I have been playing Homescapes since 2019 and have truly enjoyed the journey. I have completed all available levels, which shows how much I love this game. The puzzles, events, graphics,.

I have played this for years, reached high levels and enjoyed it, but the game has changed. I am one of a really helpful friendly supportive Team until today. The game will no longer let you chat to other members of the team. didn't even get a warning. we can no longer ask for others to exchange cards etc so you are part of a team but feel you are playing alone. I feel many will abandon the game because of this move, I will be. I feel that many

I used to like this game, however, the creators have taken away the ability to chat to other players in the same team, the levels feels like i have played them before, they have taken away some of the features, i.e: the double airplane option and it feels extremely frustrating finishing some of the levels, even the easy ones.

I LOVE this game so much. So addicting (in the best way) and enticing. I used to skip through the storyline in the past, but now going through it all is so interesting! I am now on level 855 and love the way the game has been going, but have noticed that the levels are SO HARD since about level 800, and every 3/4-ish levels, I reach a really challenging one that I am stuck on FOR DAYS. This is quite annoying, but overall love this game though. Thanks!

Loved this game and have been playing it for years, on level 20158 and am no longer getting the Expeditions, it notified me on the last two expeditions, hit continue and nothing appears, have switched tablet off, I have plenty storage, considering uninstalling. I also play Gardenscapes and have had no issues getting the expeditions on that game.

so sick of being stuck in a level, been playing the same level for weeks, it's not funny anymore will delete this boring game and unlink everything. hard level are not that hard only the regular ones. Your updates are useless.Their hard levels are their marketing strategy to buy your progress, just a waste of money and time. Requires update when there's nothing much interesting with the update.

I’ve been playing this game for months, and every time I close it, it always brings me back to the same spot, even if I was actively playing. With the new update, you removed that option and completely ruined the flow of the game. Please bring back the feature so that whenever I close the game, I can return to the exact same spot. Especially because it’s not always possible to finish a level, and sometimes I need to use my phone for other things while playing. Please fix this!

used to be good , it's just getting harder and harder to progress. I used to enjoy the expedition game but even that has gotten harder, the amount of energy needed for each task is ridiculous. now I can't even get the expedition, it's happened on the last two, the icon is covered by the safe icon so can't access the expedition. I contacted support but of no help., gave a load about device, I actually am using a brand new tablet and it's still a problem, it's obviously a game issue not my device

The levels are stupidly hard. Every level is hard to complete. And every item costs at least 7 stars. This makes the game boring and uninteresting. Just like the other players, this was fun at first 2k levels. Then a very confusing levels and irrelevant activities take place. Getting stuck for days even at the hard level is frustrating enough. You win or gifted an unlimited life but you will not or cannot proceed to another level. Its like the game wants the players to spend lots of money. Its getting boring. Mini games are childs game.

The game is not as advertised hence the low score. It gave the impression of a brain teaser type game, using various items in an order to clean up or repair a house. I'm actual fact, it's a poor man's candy crush where you unlock items for your guitar after each level. the game itself may be decent if that's what you're looking for, but I do not enjoy this type of game. 1*

I used to enjoy playing the games. Now, not anymore. The number of moves greatly reduced as I level up. Imagine you have less than 18 moves for level easy. I can't join the game tournament since I'm stuck at same level for days. Might as well uninstall to make space for other games in my phone. Playing games is supposed to be fun, not stressing you out.

I enjoy this game quite alot, i like match 3 games and choosing how the rooms look. BUT the difficulty. Im on level 650ish and its getting soooo hard. Some levels i do first time, others take days or weeks. And the price of 5 more moves after you fail is extortionate. It really is a cash grab. It is possible to play without buying coins, but prepare for a long, hard challenge. The amount of coins you get awarded is a joke considering how much stuff costs. Good luck!

The game has gotten less fun. The events (individual) are almost impossible to achieve. If you are not able or incline to spend real money forget about it. Matchington mansion gives more satisfaction in this sense. Update: the developers actually listened. For the first time an special event is going on for longer and they added ways to actually earn a decent amount of tickets within the event. Let's hope this time I can finish one...

Even though I absolutely love this game, I am very disappointed at how they have increased prices for in-app purchases as well as for the pot. Most of the prices have doubled, e.g. you only get 3000 coins instead of 5000 in the pot, you pay R39.99 instead of R19.99 for 1000 coins. The levels are very difficult and it feels like we are getting much less for your money now.

This game is quite good for boredom and I've had it for a while, but it has some problems (in my opinion). Here are my good and bad opinions on the game- 1: I got this app because of the ads I've seen on it, and the minigames looked fun. But i only get them once in a blue moon 2: I personally like decorating the house, but some colour choices and designs honestly look really weird and I would like more colours 3: like I said, it's good at wasting time. You could spend hours on 1 level.

Very nice at first, but then it gets boring and too difficult at times. The first week I get to play for over 100 levels a day, but after level 2000+ I got stuck for weeks in some impossible levels. I would never spend my money on match 3 games, so I just gave up and uninstalled it. I play games to relax, not to get depression. My life has difficult enough! PS: I wish people could sue your company for the straight frauds of ALL the misleading ads. You've robbed countless people for years now!

I have been playing this game for a couple years and I do enjoy it, have spent about $50 in the 2 years I have played. You can play this without making purchases within the game, that being said it will take you a month to pass those harder levels so it's set up to encourage you to spend to progress, if you are persistant, it can be done. The packages they offer are expensive and you don't get much for what you spend, not worth the money in my opinion,would consider if cheaper, until then NaH!

Not a bad game; however I think it's rubbish that I spend hours playing to fill up the safe with gold coins; then have to spend my own £5.99 to retrieve them. What a joke!!!! Plus my friend paid for a starter pack only to be charged twice for it. Sort yourselves out!!!! 😡😡😡😡 Plus the adverts don't represent actual game play... Big con..... Funny how you never get feedback, publishers and developers know the customer is correct.

I'm a fan of Township, so I wanted to like this game - but I can't say that Playrix's teams seem to be learning from each other. This is entirely too dependent on luck and lots of it, perhaps to increase sales of boosters, but if the levels are unbeatable even with boosters and multiple attempts, then it just feels like a cheap cash grab. No thanks; uninstalled.

I spent a reasonable amount of money on the game at the beginning because I don't expect something for nothing even though the game is "free to play". When you use up all of your power ups and still can't beat a level then you know the game is just too hard. I have played some levels over 25 times before I beat them. Even the regular levels are too difficult. I would suggest to others that they try "Lily's Garden". It is fun and has a more reasonable challenge.

Once again, an update means I can't play this on my Amazon Fire (installed with extra memory) So that's another month I can't play it on there. Too many competitions that stall the gameplay that you can't avoid, too many hard levels, too few moves and all demand money to win. I just want to build the house, that's it, but it stalls endlessly to get money. Now it demands I update to play but when I click on download there's no update to be downloaded. Can't update, can't play. Gee, thanks!

used to love this game, but the makers have changed all the rules on the players. You are encouraged to join a group and also make friends on fb with other players enabling you to exchange lives. Since being able to do so it now takes longer to get through a level and you appear to be limited to only receiving a max of 15 lives from friends a day. I have way more than 15 friends and we all send daily. They have also reduced the bonus level to something ridiculous like once every six weeks. Don't!

Great puzzle game, that turned into a pile of garbage ever since the "new way" of advertising. I wish the developers, publishers, or advertisers changed their thinking of how to advertise their product and how to bring more customers to try it. Lies that are presented with terrible ad design, the mindset of "I bet you cannot beat this level!", and poor way of showing it, makes me sick and sad thinking where we went wrong. Awesome time killer, but disgusting advertisement choices.

I have played this game for a long time (well over 1000 levels) . It used to be a great game but lately there have been so many more much harder levels that it isn't much fun to play anymore. I feel like the developers just want more and more money so make it harder so we will buy coins and boosters. I am not whining. I like hard levels but not ones that take DAYS to beat.

This isn't the game I played in the ads at all! In the ads you help the character get out of dangerous scenarios there is absolute nothing of that sort in the actual game! Truly disappointed! All I'm doing is renovating the characters parents entire house, by playing sooo many levels of what seems to be another copy of candy crush! Its ridiculous, for every tiny detail you have to play I.e. opening a package you have to play a level!! Complete waste of time!!!!! I didn't even wna giv 1 ⭐

I think this game is a bit of a scam. It seems more of a chess game than a matching game. I noticed how the levels with the bubbles always leave you with no moves to make. You put the player at such a disadvantage even taking the bonus help. Also noticed how when you only have a few moves left, thats when all the bombs and all those help appear. I think its a way to get people to spend their money on the extra moves. Its fun but its a scam.

I enjoy the game! Yes it's not as advertised but I still find it fun! my major complaints are the same as everyone else - 900 stars is too pricey for things, and wasting stars on making phones calls and other useless tasks is annoying. My biggest complaint is not being able to delay free play (30min, 1 hour, 3 hours! Who has 3 hours straight to play?!) It would be nice to be able to bank free play rewards to use when you want and in the time amount you want to use.

I gave you 9 months to fix the freezing issue. But nothing changed. I play happily for an hour and when I want to continue it doesn't open. Green screen, thats all I get. Worst of all, You don't bother answering ratings and comments! Most comments hear sound rigged. These are the same as last June. This game as good as it was at the beginning, is a scam!

Totally different game than what is advertised. I was really disappointed that it's just another Candy Crash type grind fest forcibly intertwined with a "story". One plays one or more matching tiles game to "perform" ridiculously simple stuff like "feed the bird" or "greet the guest" & so on. Which is ok unless you get sucked into buying anything with actual money. The later levels are clearly designed to frustrate you and tempt you to buy stuff to get through tough levels. Therefore 2 stars.

Do not let your kids play this game. If you do, disable in-game purchases. The game has levels that are impossible to pass without purchases and will bombard the player with suggestions for purchases. In the end I got bored at not being able to progress after they give a super hard level and only 10 moves to complete it and then being asked "are you sure? You're going to lose all your progress". Don't bother.

I've been playing this game for quite a while. I've been stuck at level 1259 for a few days and it looks like I won't be getting any more Halloween decorations. So frustrating! I'm actually thinking of uninstalling the game as the difficulty of some levels has gotten ridiculous. Also at this point I need 3-5 stars for one action... stopped being fun.

Not as advertised! What was advertised seemed interesting. Actual game isn't anything like it. Don't download if you're expecting a choose your own adventure/puzzle solving problem game, because it's just a lie. The sister-game, Gardenscapes, is also a disappointment for the same reasons. You shouldn't be running those ads. It's blatant false advertising.

False advertising. Only way to get through levels is by spending money. Ad was misleading nothing like the game. Even if you spend money in the app it doesn't ensure you win anything the game is built on luck. Blocks don't always fall into logical places when removing a block(s). You're also forced to sign into a group chat, adopt a cat and a dog and the app makes you waste stars to care for them and other things no option to progress until you do it. Would be better if you pick where stars go!

Cute game, but requires three stars to progress and sometimes 4 as you get further. I really hate this. It's not fair when you work so hard to pass one level! Also, 900 in game dollars to continue?? When it takes more than ten levels to get that much? I got up to 617 and then couldn't progress because too many stars required. Plus you basically have to pay to play after awhile. It's not fair Devs.

I'm addicted but not enjoying it. It is pretty common to get stuck on levels which if you're determined like me you will spend money excessively for very little in return!! Many levels need boosters/power ups but they cost sooo much. I had no idea it was similar to candy crush. I downloaded it as the game was advertised very differently. I thought it was some kind of health & safety multiple choice. I will probably end up frustrated & deleting it. Download if you're a big spender. lol

Got boring quite quickly, it's just another candy crush clone with the 'reward' being that it advances the story and let's you pick a few furniture items. The home scaping is very loose, there's little interaction here. They've also included the mini games you see in the adverts probably to avoid any false advertising but they're inconsequential and the art style is completely different to the rest of the game.

I love this game! Some elements of gameplay are very RNG-based, which can be a bother, and you must be careful when to use your boosters cause you dont want to be without them. But all in all this is the best game experience I've had with mobile games since it has no ads and is so well polished in every aspect! I love the story and renovating the house to my liking (though options are limited) proves fun too. This game soomehow makes me feel warm and safe !

I've been playing this game for a while (currently level 12,116), and lately, I've noticed the game is designed to cheat. Especially the planes. Also, they removed the side games I liked. I understand wanting to make money, but don't cheat me out of winning. Also, the amount of "money" you get for finishing a level has gone way down. When I first started the amount I'd get after a win was like 150-200+ coins, now I get like 25-40 coins. Will not continue much longer.

It is outrageous that a game advertising one thing is a completely different experience from it. If it were a store over here it would be penalized for false ads, too bad I have no idea how to do that here. Other than that the game itself is rather okay if you have patience and are rich. Ridiculous how much you need to do/have for each "harder" level. It's stressful. I won't recommend it.

Think you're getting a puzzle game? Think again. I've watched the ads for over a months flashing across my screen and finally decided to give it a shot. It's boring as hell. You have to buy items in the game and you do that by playing a candy crush style game. Back and forth, boring slow game with a lot of text, then stupid crush game. Screw that. Uninstalled after 5 minutes

The game starts off actually achievable, and then very quickly you find that it takes either 20+ tries to complete a level, or there's just no way around it without purchasing coins or extras. You start earning less for completing levels, and every other level is a "super hard" level. It just becomes completely unplayable and becomes a source of frustration rather than just being an enjoyable game. All these apps are the same.

The game is fun ,but I can agree with other people that some of the levels are RIDICULOUSLY hard. And I'm only on level 20. Sometimes you don't get enough moves! Could you make the lives cheaper?Being able to ask for lives is a helpful feature but the only social media there is Facebook. You could add Whatsapp and Instagram and Twitter and things. Facebook isn't the only one. I hope I haven't complained to much but I'm really not happy.Im likely going to delete the app soon. Sorry,

Its a real shame the way the game has developed into a cash grab. I played this game for multiple years since it used to give 65 energy for a completed level. when it did it felt like i challenge which was challenging but doable. but now it feels like it's impossible, considering there is not enough time to complete the main story nevermind the bonuses. it feels like a waste of time considering how much money you have to put into the game to feel like you've 'won', even if that's just the story.

It's a cool game but I hope you get to see your FB friend's house too, i mean i know you have the same house but the design isn't. Another thing is, please find a way where we can earn additional money. Like we're playing for 18 levels or less only to surrender it for just 5 moves, 900 is too much dear. Aaannd, there are so many extra activities that we didn't even need like greet the visitor lol, buy the cat stuff.

I am changing my review from five stars to three. This game is absolutely beautiful and totally fun... Until you get to the levels approaching 100. I'm convinced some of these levels are bordering on Impossible even with as many boosters as you could buy with real life money. That's not fun. Gardenscapes was playable. This is not. This stinks like a bunch of executives in a boardroom decided how they could squeeze every last penny out of the player. I feel bamboozled.

The game is not like what they advertise, infact it's candy crush game with story mode (not that boring though). The game play they advertise was a one time deal that i got to play at around level 250. To advance in this game (for F2P) you need to invest lot of time. The higher the level the harder the game becomes which is not the problem. The problem is the life the player has is only 5 and for f2p someone needs to spend more than 30 minutes/day if want to advance in game.

Another fake "free" game that charges you a lot of money to progress. It draws you in with its charming characters and interesting storylines, but only has two different puzzle types on repeat to progress. Until, of course, it programs it so you can't progress beyond a certain point without paying, using psychological FOMO tactics against you to spend all your points then money in-game to continue. Too bad. I almost spent a few dollars to support it and I'm hella glad I didn't. Time waster!

Glad I waited a few weeks to write a review. The game is fun at first but then (as many reviewers pointed out) it becomes next to impossible to complete levels without powerups and while you can earn some for free, you'd still need way more of them to get ahead. It's not really fair and becoming less and less enjoyable. who has time to spend 10 lives on one level?! brutal.

Some levels are just ridiculously hard! You are forced to spend money just to beat one level. Also, I can't believe I have to give 2-4 stars to do something so pointless, or not really that important, like calling someone sometimes would cost you 2-3 stars. It's so annoying! I expected a lot with all the updates you are doing, but I am always disappointed. I used to really love and enjoy this game, but now, I just get annoyed playing it.

Its a rip off. Costs a fortune to progress through the game .That being said, it is addictive to see what the next task is. Developers will be happy because that is their objective. I think that the developers should allow unlimited lives and coins after a certain amount of money has been spent such as $$500 max. Other games can be purchased outright for much, much less.So how about it guys?? Come to the party for all your long term players.

Dishonest: This game is nothing like the advertising... seriously, what is the developer doing creating such false advertising. The game itself is quite good when you get into it... Personally however, if the gameplay was actually like the adverts, I think I would enjoy it more. As a message to the developer - please advertise real gameplay as opposed to false expectations. It's just not enjoyable to be let down like that. Still, great, fun game. Just left disappointed of what could have been.

Utterly disappointed! After years of playing this game and making countless in game purchases. The creators of this game have taken it upon themselves to remove me as leader of the team I created and paid for with my money! And their reason, I was inactive for more than 14 days! After years of playing and many long breaks from the game in the past and never having this problem, suddenly there is a 14 day activity rule! The crators of the game are happy to take your money, but not happy to help!!

Had another account but restarting a new one just for fun. great game except i hate it when the rocket power up flew to the rainbow powerup. i wanna keep it but since it was used i lost some level which cd have been won.

This game is a joke now. Playing same levels for a week with all power ups and can't advance.Seems to be a money grab now. I have this game for few years. It used to be fun to play. Now levels are impossible to complete even with the 30 min free life and power ups. Takes weeks to get through some levels. When you haven't got 900 coins to buy more moves they offer you 35 moves. When you have the 900 coins you only can buy 5 more moves. They just want to get you to spend your money. Disappointing.

The game is super fun, killing boredom, love that. There was an update recently which completely changed the animations, the looks of power ups, and honestly, I think they look awful. The previous ones were much better, and looking at many bombs or paper planes exploding was super satysfying. But after changing the animations it looks much worse. The idea was good, 3d animations, but it didn't turn out so well. Bring them back pls 🙏🏻 Overall I really like the game

When you've spent yet more hard earned stars, which you've painstakingly earned completing almost impossible levels (once you've progressed as far as the kitchen), on mundane tasks like making a call, opening a box, answering a door and chasing some bird across the room, you'll realize that the developers are not in for the long steady game. This is yet again a flash in the pan, aimed at grabbing money as quick as it can. Stick to the steady classics, avoid this rubbish like the plague

It's an alright game but I've been stuck in level 28 for a week now. It's very clear that you either have to pay for powerups or waste your time hoping you get lucky and clear the level.. can't see myself spending money on this game in hopes I can clear a level. Would be nice if difficult levels aren't made for to spend money on. Sadly, I am going to be uninstalling this game.

the current monotary system is a toxic one, the game is for all ages but in all cannot be played without spending real money to finish a puzzle, i tried both.. wanna know a fun fact? once you buy some gold to increase the amount of moves you make the game instantly gives you the correct colors and increases the amount of ''special'' blocks(explosives,colorpickers etc), i cant do a complete review as that would require more than 500 words, at any rate i can advice not to play this game.

Money grab plain and simple. While not the worst one out there unless you wish to sink more into the game each month than it would be to buy something of this style outright you will be waiting around a lot and rarely able to complete various timed events. The reason I'd have a game like this is to unwind on break or to occupy me while waiting... not just play a few minutes to wait for refills or adds ect. It also does not measure up the the adds. They were misleading

I've been playing this a long time.. it's just getting frustrating now. Yesterday I spent money to get through the level, it then froze and went off.. when it came back on, I had to start the level again, but had still taken the coins from before it froze. Some levels are so hard, so then to freeze when you pay to help get you through is a joke! Not happy 😒

I'm finally deleting this game. I commented, I suggested, but yet again, there's a prompt to pave more of the outside. Who are you people who are trying to pave the planet? Chinese? Besides, the appeal was to renovate a house. I haven't done any inside work in at least 100 levels, probably more. If I wanted to pave a garden, I would play GardenScapes. Seriously, it's poor design to ONLY offer choices of paving stones, with no eco-friendly options! Please, please, please, let one of the 3 garden choices be to level the grass, or lay sod, not pave the whole thing. I had no choice but to pave the whole garden and that's just wrong.

They have made gameplay on harder levels so insanely difficult that it takes days, over a week sometimes to pass levels, I'm assuming to force players to purchase upgrades and packs. The moves allocated to difficult levels make them impossible to beat no matter how many extra bombs you have. It's too much. I'm so over this game now, it's a waste of time and money. Edit: I'm glad they made it so hard as a cash grab because it pushed me to uninstall and stop wasting time and money on this.

Beyond pissed off!! Won 2nd place in a team tourney with my team of 3 players. Instead of having the prize of 90000 plot three-way, as any normal algorithm would do, we only got 3000 (which I didn't find out about until I looked in the FAQs, because you don't get told that in the game)! I was stupid to spend actual money on this game. Also gameplay sux, you make a special combo, the bricks go, but you don't get the combo. I should have taken this as a sign and stopped playing. Worst spent£25-30

Starting of this game, they will let you pass all the levels. But once you reach level 400+ above, they will start to make you lose, start to not let you mix and match with the colours to get a bomb or something. Start to not let you pass your level. Why? Because they want you to purchase their item in order to pass the level. They hook you to the game and make sure you cannot wait for it and purchase their item(Live♥️) to continue playing it. Rating 3/10 Bad.

Title: Fun but Too Hard to Progress, The game is really fun and challenging at first, but as you go on, the difficulty spikes. The levels become so tough that you need boosters or coins to progress. The problem is, coins are too expensive and the amount you earn from normal levels is way too low—often just 10 coins. It becomes frustrating because you either need to grind a lot or spend money to continue, which takes away from the fun.

I love this game. I've invested time and money into. The lvls get harder and to beat, as time goes on. You get stuck on lvls for days, spend money to try and beat it, and nothing. I've seen help a friend out before, but have not seen it in ages. This is something that should be brought out, once a month. But your company is creedy and all about the bottom dollar. So until this is brought back and out once a month, I will no longer spend money on the game, and call all players to do the same.

The advertisement of this game and the game itself is so different. Dont waste your time on this, you're better off downloading the candy crush game directly and playing that instead. Such a waste of time... because after the first few levels, it becomes impossible to move forward and the coins you get is so so so little to decorate your house.... They definitely want you to pay in order to play.

Lately, the game messes with you to make it impossible to pass a level, especially if you're very far into the game. (I'm currently at lvl 5000+.) You swipe a piece in one direction, and it'll move in another, screwing your over. And without passing those levels to get extra energies, time limited adventures are impossible to be completed in time. The devs probably think that by doing this, we'll spend more money on this game. Guess what? I've lost interest in this game and I'm quitting.

It was fun to play, good animation and interactive but you need to spend a lot of money on coins. 900 coins for 5 moves! And then it increases. You can't pass these levels without getting more moves so you need to buy coins. There are hard and super hard levels but these seem easier? Weird. Any help you buy seems to go really quickly. At one point it completely reset and I lost the gold power powerball even though I wasn't losing! I have surpassed 1000 levels lol but I can't keep playing

Im like almost 700 levels deep and only opened up like less than 10 areas. Which is pretty gay, coz theres too many little things to do in between, "recieve a gift" blah blah there goes all the stars you've earned. And then it's pretty much just candy crush with different items instead of candy, I thought it would be more puzzles like advertised.

The game becomes unfair at higher levels. It has two stages but only 15 moves, making it nearly impossible to complete without buying extra moves. No matter how strategically I play, the number of moves is just too low. The only way to get extra moves is to stop playing the game for few weeks, which is frustrating and unreasonable. It feels like the game is designed to force players into purchases rather than skill-based gameplay. Very disappointing. Uninstalled.

I played this game up to some 38th level. Got stuck on a level with 11 moves to clear 27 foams or whatever. Seriously?!?!?!? I’ve already spent enough money on this game. The number of levels where it’s IMPOSSIBLE to win without paying just keeps climbing every 100 levels, but 11 moves is straight-up ridiculous for this one. You don’t give a damn about players, so I’m done caring about your game. Uninstalled.

I've been playing this game for four years, but I couldn’t play for five months. When I resumed, I found new rules seemingly designed to encourage spending. Reducing coins earned in standard levels from 50 to just 10 makes it too hard to save for tough levels. Now, some levels require spending coins to continue, even if you have power-ups. If you can't earn enough coins to save for when you need them, you're forced to buy. It's really disappointing.

Game is not as advertised, it is a cheap candy crush, there is NO scenario fix or destroy. Some of the levels are far too hard early on that they clearly are trying to force you to pay for the extras to win. Some of the levels are nothing more than pure luck. 30min life reload time is too long. At this rate won't play long as been stuck on the same level for 2 days and approx 60+ failed attempts.

The game is different from what they show in the ads. If you see the ad, you'd think you'll be spending time repairing everything in your house but NOOOOO. YOU SPEND MOST OF YOUR TIME MATCHING AND SOLVING PUZZLES INSTEAD. The game says "redesign your beautiful mansion while solving puzzles along the way" but I honestly think it's the other way around. Your time revolves around solving puzzles.. Never ending puzzlesssssss. 😒

Well, this incarnation of the game was ok when I started again from the beginning recently, but it's now been stuck all afternoon saying that it's 0% updated. I'm fed up. That's it for today. If it's the same tomorrow I'm uninstalling it. Again. At the end of the day there are so many of these candycrush clones that it won't be missed. I'm certainly not going to be conned into making any of the massively overpriced in-game purchases. £0.99 maybe, £8.99 in your dreams!

On update: Thank God you removed extra lifes from wheel, at one point I had 30+... What's up with you people, when I started I was frustrated with star earning, but it's really not that hard. I play Gardenscapes too. It goes slow with progress because they can't make up millions of rooms and if you do it in a day what's the point. This is a match game, so you have to play match, but it's not a stupid match game. It has bunch of other fun stuff to do. But you can't ask creators to cut out match part, or to not make it harder along the way. I am at level 500 and something and not bored, and at Gardenscapes I am level 1200 and something. Yes, some areas are more interesting than the others but I love this game and give it a 5 star rating. I never had a glitch in this game, and am surprised that others did... Just want to say, that with orangery part is a bit boring, but am intrigued by the romance of our favourite butler, is this a thing, or am I only tripping... Good work guys, game is so good!

I liked this game initially but had to uninstall as it is impossible to progress through the levels without spending money! The further you go through the game the more stars you need to complete tasks and the 5 life limit is ridiculous! But no doubt another opportunity for game developers to make money as it costs to refill- or wait 20 minutes per 'life'. Also the butler is so annoying, that weird winky thing he does at the start of each level? Creepy

I love this game as well as garden scapes what makes me begin to dislike it is the fact that one has to spend weeks on a level all to use 4 to 6 stars in nothing special. It is really ANOYING. Hope you work on that. This game is for fun and to test your brain but doesn't mean having headache for fun. A game where I have to spend more than a month on just one game is sickening. I'm beginning to be discouraged. I so loved this game till it started becoming a headache .

False advertising. Just another match 3 game, Candy crush clone, nothing at all like the add. Even though I like some match 3 games, I refuse to keep any with false advertising like this. How hard is it to be honest in the add? They don't care though, I fell for it, downloaded and tried it. That's their business model, they made their money.

Game is nice for awhile but by the 50s and 60s levels, which only take a few days to get to, becomes nearly impossible to complete unless you use up most/all your power ups and even then may not complete. Getting stuck on levels among hundreds more for days (game should not get really hard that fast), not my thing, uninstalled after a couple weeks. Plus, the ads for this game (from other games) and what gameplay should be, do not represent anything what the game actually is.

There is more Candy crush saga mini games than the ones on the ads. For a game which is supposed to make you relax, this is failing. You will reach a hard level and you will go crazy to go through it without paying actual money. It gets more frustrating than enjoyable. Will I recommend it - if you like Candy crush saga, yes; otherwise don't waste your time

My rating has changed due to misleading advertising. While I enjoyed the game itself, I will not be playing anymore, nor will I try any of the other "scapes" games due to the misleading ads I've seen all over. It really annoying to see advertisements for games that have gameplay shown that isn't in the game. Until the misleading ads end, I will not play, download or recommend any "scapes" games as I feel this is both dishonest and unethical marketing

I have been playing this for years. Each time I change to a new phone, I will still download and play this game. Boost can be bought for real money, but their weakness combined with price (spend USD 1 on a boost that has a chance of maybe 10% to be useful ?) work as an effective deterrent against actually spending money.
