I will most likely spend a bit soon just to show a little support, even though i don't feel the need to buy anything. The minigames are actually like the ads, which is nice i suppose.

I had only downloaded this game when I saw an ad, where you'd have to select multiple options! But when I downloaded the game, I found out it was like candy crush! And we only have 5 lives! Level 28 is IMPOSSIBLE to beat! I get very angry every time I try the level 5 times! Unacceptable! I also play candy crush and I'm on level 89, and the levels are easy unlike this game! If I could rate 0 stars I would! EVERYONE, NEVER EVER INSTALL THIS GAME

This game used to be so much fun and you used to be able to play for free, getting all the cool seasonal event decorations and more. Now, unless you want to pay an absurd amount of real money, you miss out. Advertisements are thrown in our faces. What was once a great free game to play endlessly, is now an infuriating cash grab. Almost level 9000 and I'm about to give up on this app. Been playing ever since it came out... not impressed.

The ads give the impression of a pull-the-pin game. It is not a pull-the-pin game. They do this because 1) it's trending and 2) it's easy to animate quickly. The actual game is like Candy Crush, but every level is really hard, and they barely give you anything for the completion. It's not hard to make a good pull-the-pin game, and if they did this, I think it would be much more enjoyable for everyone.

Very disappointed. Good game, but needs lots of money to work. Stuck at a level, and there are never enough blue and yellow items to collect. Bombs etc do not appear in time to help. Then asks for more spending. Would buy the game, but not an option. Still stuck. Only two doughnuts until it is too late and the game is over. This is the way to gambling addiction. Not for me. later. I uninstalled, and played two similar games alternatively. They both stuck at the same time. Now gone too.

It wasn't exactly as advertised. Most of the time you are just playing a variation of candy crush, with ridiculously hard levels. You have to do these hard candy crush games loads of times to get just one improvement, and as you have a limit to the number of tries, it takes days to make any progress. The actual fun stuff (renovating the house and the mini puzzles) are rare. I don't mind paying a little bit for a decent game, but I resent being effectively forced to. I'm considering uninstalling.

Very interactive.like the butler point of view. Ok people I understand the repetitive levels, the Hard levels, and the similarities to other games! but it compensates you alot! with all the free little games in the games, so you get a chance to pass those levels and if you leave they always welcome back with free stuff y'all know what I mean.

As many other reviewers reported, this is absolutely frustrating false advertising. After watching hundreds of ads showing a strategy game where you work out which pin to pull to achieve the aim, I thought it looked fun and installed it. I've even tried twice - the 'home' one and the 'fish' one. It's just a babyish 3-swap game like candy crush for toddlers. DON'T WASTE YOUR TIME DOWNLOADING IT! Unless you're a 3- year old and want to play candy crush!

The ad for the game is totally misleading! It's a match 3 type of game, if you are into them, then go for it. But it most definitely is not the minigame-choose your level type of game. You might get such a level once in awhile inbetween the match 3 levels but that's it. So stop misleading the people to download it.

You shouldn't have to wait for 2 days to be given new rewards to help you get through stages... It seems as if they don't really want you to play the game as they make it impossible to continue playing and therefore you have no option but to exit the game... I deleted it... It seemed like a great game that many could get attached to its just slow with rewards and not many lives.

Really like this game, very addictive but would be better if you got 2 stars for the hard levels and 3 stars for the super hard levels as it can take ages for you to get stars to complete the quest. Also when you play the extra game with the cat, once you completed some of the levels but ran out of lives you shouldn't have to do them all over again, it would be better to start where you left off. That's why I gave 4 stars and not 5.

Misleading adverts lure you into downloading the game that you think will be fun and challenging, and is, in fact, a 3 match game. I am very disappointed, as I have tried the game a gew times and thought... "maybe I need to open such and such room and then I will be able to fix the leaking sink/fire in the kitchen, etc." Even the game icon is misleading... Come on...

Love the game even though there are times and some levels that are a bit difficult to get through. There are 2 things that for me would improve it: firstly, instead of gaining rewards of 2,3 or 4 hours free lives, an option to chose your reward would be better. This is because I tend to play as I'm relaxing in the evening and at say 10pm I don't want to be playing into the early hours! Secondly, an option to use the power ups during a level instead of at the beginning would be good.

The premise is fun and really playable but a few things really annoyed me. Firstly, the events would be amazing if they weren't obligatory they really bother me when I'm playing and they take me away to start an event I don't want to be in. Secondly, the amount of moves. They get so little that it becomes so difficult to play. It is designed to drain your resources and coins, I hate it and by the looks of other reviews everyone else does too. Put in a reasonable amount of moves for the levels!!!

I previously played this game and got to high levels. enjoyed the game. I'm giving it 1 star based on false advertising. in the ad it shows game play to be a choice of different items to pick to fix things. if wrong item is choosen things go wrong! that game play looks fast and fun. however the game play isn't like that. the actual game is good, but slowly progressive and should advertise how the game actually is.

It's a good game until you realise they've made the levels so hard that there is no way of winning them unless you pay real money. I'll end up deleting it as it's no longer fun. A shame really, as it could actually be a good game! The marketing is also really misleading. All the adverts display mini games but you come across them so rarely that they hardly count as a level.

Amazing game. But not enough moves and not enough "lifes" to play. I have to wait forever to keep playing, and then the moves make me loose the game and wait forever again. Please, could you change that? Edit: levels too difficult, we spend two, three days to win one, and then we spend our stars just feeding the cat or playing with it. I love the game, but this is getting boring. 😑

Downloaded this game because i really love gardenscapes. At first i really enjoyed the game but not anymore. There is no spin wheel, the levels extremely hard to beat with only a few moves (spent few days just to beat 1 level), no hearts-refill after completed all of task of a day. If u could make it easier it would be fun and enjoyable

I love this game! fun, addictive, and no ads 😍 I don't get why people are complaining here saying that some levels are impossibly hard it force you to buy coins or whatever to complete it. well, i'm almost at level 10000 and never experience that. of course some levels are extra hard that i'm running out of hearts but then i stop playing, DOING REAL STUFF IN REAL LIFE and come back later to try again. always works.

I was interested in this game as I saw it in a pop ad in another game I was playing, I really enjoy homescapes, however the reason why I downloaded it was because the ad for the game shows various things you need to do save or fix things in a particular area, sort of like point and click, it would be wonderful if the developers incorporated this type of challenge in the game.

I really like this game it passes the time. I think you should be able to change the main character and name and design how you like, with a female option too. Also I think the hard levels are WAY too hard. it wastes all my lives and have to wait ages for more. lives waiting time is too long. 900 coins just to receive an extra 5 MOVES?

Yeah, as others have said, the game becomes very frustrating once you hit level 50. The appeal of such a game is that you'd be able to renovate a home, but as these challenges increase, you'd spend more time playing those stupid Candy Crush mini games instead. If I wanted to play Candy Crush, I'd install Candy Crush instead of this game. Also, the ads for this game lied about the gameplay. It's actually 90% of the time Candy Crush mini games.

I love the home renovation part of the game and all the dialogue. The developers made getting bonuses easy and it makes a huge difference. Now I'm close to level 5000 and sure, sometimes I get totally stuck on a level, but progress is fun. Hope I get to enjoy this game for a long time still! For sure the most time I've spent on a mobile game.

I've seen a lot of(emphasis on "a lot") misleading ads, I usually never leave comments but I feel so deceived I had to leave a 1 star review. There may be a point in the game where it looks like the ads but I'm not playing that first bs game they make you play and definitely not twice. I made the mistake of playing the first one thinking "hopefully it'll be the real game now" but the second task was the same thing and definitely NOT what they've been advertising👎👎👎

waste of money. the game in itself is good, but the levels are almost impossible (even the non-difficult ones) without powerups, extra moves and extra lives. They don't give you enough in the game to go by without purchasing things. There's also the prospect that instead of renovating the house all the time, you're using stars doing stuff like going to sleep, answering the door or opening packages/letters, and feeding the cat and parrot. the stars are hard enough to earn alone without that.

This game has a decent story line, but won't allow much progress through the levels unless money is spent.  I prefer games which allow watching ads as an alternative to spending money, especially during the early stagez of the game when I am not yet convinced that money will be well spent.  Like others on here, I downloaded the game because of an ad, but I am reading that the ad gave a totally false impression of what the game is supposed to be.

It's a beautiful and fun game,where there are lots of options. And the best part is RENOVATING and DESIGNING and also freeing the people from the locks . We can unlock new rooms too!!! It's also a very challenging game which also acts like puzzles where it makes it more fun to see what happens next... It's a very fun game👍😃

I really did love the game but the further I come in the game the less I like it, because not only are the levels insanely difficult but you also need to get so many stars before you can actually do anything. For instance I'm past level 1000 and now I struggle with every single level sometimes for weeks and then have to get 5 stars to do one task. Its really annoying actually and I'm not the only one. I know lots of people who stopped playing because of this.

First, as mentioned, false ad. Second, this game is designed to make you spend real money for an expensive pack. Unless you decide to go broke for a GAME, you don't need to play this. Third. The levels are painfully hard almost every level requiring you to have a booster any further from the 700th level. Uninstalled it before emptying my wallet on this.

love the game but getting fed up with the constant updates. seems like every time I start the game I have to wait for an update! however the actual game is really good. I love the variations in the match 3 levels and enjoy getting to see the house improve. would be better if there was more consistency in styles within rooms - in the kitchen i can't find a table chair combo that match each other and the sofa styles don't seem to match much in there either.

Update. Since tournaments were introduced I'm no longer enjoying this game. You can't earn stars during them and there's no option but to take part in them. They're too hard with not enough goes to get anywhere even if you pay for a golden ticket. It seems to me the only way to beat many of the levels is to buy coins as well and I've had enough after years of enjoying it I no longer get any pleasure from it. Apart from that the game is still good. Please consider making tournaments voluntary.

Disappointed with the gameplay because it is not even close to what they advertise. So if you are here because you saw another ad pop up which shows they give you multiple tools to solve a puzzle, this is not for you. It's just another Candy Crush version with a lot more graphics and story and money involved. Total disappointment.

i used to love this game i found it relaxing and enjoyable now not so much i get that some levels are going to be hard but they shouldn't be so hard that your forced to purchase bonuses to complete it and then when you do half the time they dont work. i think some changes need to be made to make the game good again. not everybody has the finances to constantly purchase bonuses that are not going to work. very disappointed.

The game is a waste of time and money. You will sit stuck for days on one level which forces you to need their very expensive materials. You build up extra coins, which you then have to pay for, so the rewards you can get are not even worth it. Each level completed gives you a star, but to upgrade a part of themansion you may need 2 to 4 stars and then it will be to just plant shrubs in the other side. So just planting these can cost you and then it does not come with the satisfaction of upgrade

The level gets more and more ridiculous as it progresses. The move limit is too strict it forces me to use items, which I must buy it using in-game currency. Problem is, I can't even grind money by playing previous levels or whatsoever so this app is indirectly forcing me to use real money. Not really enjoyable for someone who's looking for a fun casual game.

Too hard (absolutely hell) and wasted a lot of times. Like pay to win. I'll rarely come back when my life need a really serious puzzle game that will never reward my brain until I pass an impossible level for free player. (Just annoyed) But it's fine cuz it's play for free. Don't have to rush but need timessss to complete a house. Another complaining, can you just ads us like your main game ? I mean "Main" not "Mini" (fake) . I've played your game before, the ads was not like this.

I enjoyed the game in the beginning. I liked playing match-3 games and how the levels got challenging as I progressed. Something I didn't enjoy was the tasks and how we were charged one or two stars at times and sometimes Austin would do those things himself which made me really upset. Can we not get charged for things like unlocking a closet or opening a box or calling someone for 2 stars

Its sad that you guys have to scam people into downloading this. You portray it in ads as a game where you have to solve puzzles to save the guys life, when in reality you spend 90% of the game playing a candy crush ripoff and buying furniture. If you thought this was like in the ads DO NOT DOWNLOAD this waste of time. Graphics and gameplay is fine, but it is NOT at all what you advertise.

Love playing Gardenscapes so came to give this a try and ended up regretting it. This is SO much harder than Garden. I was hoping for a nice casual game, but it ended up being a long slog for every star. If you want a challenge, then Homescapes is the game for you. If you like the difficulty level of Gardenscapes, steer clear.

Positives : Cute ,well made, clean graphics and interractive map . Easy to use UI. Negatives: Pay to play for the most part since you need to either spend all your lives to pass one level or pay to get boosters , more lives etc. Can't describe the gameplay as "entertaining" as i can only spend around 10 mins playing it before i run out of lives and then having to wait until they recharge again.

good game to players that like to renovate things but once you get to around level 20+ beating the levels become seriously hard if you have no booster items like me, I've been trying to get past level 23 but with no success or I get to just needing 1 more move to pass the level then I suddenly run out of moves? very disappointed in that aspect of the gamecas it just anger's me and makes the game less enjoyable to play.

The game is good, I enjoy playing it. To little coins for the levels you guys need to take a look at these things because you can get fed up and delete the game especially when you're on a level for days but, other than that it's a good game. Would have given 5 stars but you need to give more coins and also the 1 life is taking to long 20 minutes plus plus you need to change it.

I have been stuck several times on many levels, sometimes playing that level at least 30 times or more. To me there is not enough bang for your buck when you pass a level. Only 1 star and sometimes 100 coins depending on the level, but usually only 50 to 60 coins. Then, what you have to use the stars for is sometimes ridiculous. Use a star to phone someone...not worth it. Pretty much at the end of my rope with this game. Also $900 coins for 5 more lives...when you can't pass levels 30 times.

Quite enjoyable if you are a master of such games. But it's quite tough too at the same time. Lot of events, rewards, and decorations to win, keep you motivated and interested in playing it. Decorations and scenery are wonderful, but the decor, furniture, etc choices are very limited, three types only to be exact, still they make a change. A funny story full of adventures. You'll get connected to the story and characters easily. But mind you, every task costs many stars. Hope it helps.

This game is addicting.4 stars since it made me believe that there's a mini game like the one they show in the ads. And to those who keep saying that they can't pass a hard level without spending real money💰 bruuh it's not even that hard😕 you just have to figure out how to beat the level. I never spent a cent and still managed to go up to level 1,256. UPDATE : I GOT A NEW PHONE AND FOUND OUT THE MINI GAME IS REAL BUT MAYBE NOT ALL DEVICES ARE LUCKY ENOUGH TO HAVE IT. changed to 5 stars!

This game sucks. Gotta either have the patience of a saint or pay money to advance on the higher levels. Once you get past lvl 1500 you get hard or super hard levels every 2 levels. Waste of time. Didn't spend any money on this game which is what they want. Looking for dollars. Unless you enjoy spending 3 days per level.

It's not fair anymore! You finished the normal levels and then you have to wait for new levels. During this period, some old levels are available to play, it's acceptable but the problem is that these levels were chosen from very difficult levels, and you'll stuck in and therefore can't finish tournaments, seasons, etc. Cuz you need 100 times more than the players who playing normal levels, e.g. now you earn 2× prize and normally I played 50 normal levels in day, but now I could finish just 8!

2019: I love the storyline of the game, and the creativity in developing the characters and their speech/movements. Definitely recommend! 2025: The game has lost its appeal to me now. It feels as though it has become a money grab and the updates to the graphics take away from what it used to be. I know change is to be accepted, but change for the better, not this. Very disappointed and I don't play as often as I used to as even the easy levels are almost unbeatable now and I'm stuck for days.

In the Atlantis challenge, I couldn't pass through the Tower Viewer. Tried numerous times. Seems like the game creators don't really care about the people playing it, nor the game itself, but care mostly about the money they make from their 'deals'. No optional help in Chat Support. Seems like Playrix don't really fix the game's bugs. Disappointing.

love the game at first..but when you reached the higher level, it gets hard to finish a game. need to purchase coins so you can have extra boosters than can help you pass a level. was stuck at a certain level, can't push through..Don't have much coins to have extra hearts and boosters. I'm playing this game to kill time amd enjoy..why making it hard to pass a level without boosters. so sad :(

First of all, your advertisements are so bloody misleading... you are literally fooling people to download this game and after downloading it everybody realizes that it's just another version of Candy Crush! Some levels are so hard that i get stuck for days... and about spending coins, seriously what the hell!? we have to spend 900 just to get 5 extra moves and each level gives us only 50? like what the hell! This game really sucks. Thinking of uninstalling it. Such a waste!

I've spent enough money getting to the point I'm at. Time to delete. Fixing up the house was what attracted me to the game, but each room requires beating many levels to earn stars. More and more game levels are too difficult, sometimes paying for extra moves still doesn't help. Stars are required to "call" characters, start new days, other meaningless things. Rooms when finished are way too cluttered. I would have been happier with simply decorating the rooms, with simpler decor.

So, this game personally is one of my favorites. But there is one minor problem, I just don't like the fact you have to wait 30 whole minetes! Oh also don't like the fact that you need to spend 900 coins just for 5 moves! And then you need over 1000 coins for ANOTHER 5 MOVES!!! Please fix the problems I have with the game because it is unacceptable. Please reply.

This game is awful. It's almost impossible to get power ups to go together so you can actually complete the levels. I'm only on level 67, just starting the second room. Unless you buy more coins then you're stuck. If you find spending money to complete the game fun, go for it.Total rip off, don't get it. Would give zero stars if I could.

This game used to be fun when it first started, but now both this and Gardenscapes are just ridiculous impossible now. The hard and super hard levels have gotten too ridiculously hard, and when you finally get to a normal level, it's just as B.S. as the harder levels. Getting a normal level is just as rare as actually beating a level. Also, all the rewards you get for all the stuff you do is absolutely piss poor. This game used to actually reward you for your hard work.

The game is nice 👌... But, when you get higher in levels it becomes more difficult. I played just one level for more one week, it is annoying, frustrating and I nearly deleted the game but held on. So I suggest you should be giving us better rewards when we finish playing the game. After playing such an annoying game then I just see my reward is just one star and 50 coins and that's not fair at all. Don't get me wrong it's a nice game but you have to make some changes. Thanks 😊🌚.

the adverts for this game are so misleading. exactly the same as gardenscapes and the "challenges" you see in the advertisement are nothing like the game. just a simple match 'em game with a rubbish back story to make it seem different. not worth downloading or playing for any amount of time. definitely need to sort out the advert as well. bordering on false advertisement

Not the game I was expecting - the video ad showed a drag and drop game where you have to pick the right tool to fix an issue. What I got was another hateful match 3 game without the fun looking bit from the video ad. I've since come to read the reviews and it seems that part in the video ad doesn't actually exist! Lesson learned, read the reviews first!

Worst puzzle game, hard and money grabbing. They give you hard puzzle that only could be solve by buying booster using cash. And the worst of it, the game do not look like their adds. No fixing game with choosing tools, only puzzle game candy crush wannabe but with insane difficulties. Don't install this game, save your quotas to other honest and enjoyable game. I will give it minus 100 star if I could.

The game is fun if you're into matching up items like candy crush... however not what I thought I was going to be playing, given that the advert is for a totally different game! Highly addictive, and it's fun to build up the house, but levels are too difficult too early on in the game. I also have gardenscapes and found these levels easier to complete.

Pretty sure I already wrote a review but I'll put another one in. There is an incredibly unfair difficulty spike at level 118. The way the level is designed makes it nearly impossible to make matches that will impact your progress and due to the randomness of the falling blocks, the level doesn't/rarely gives you power ups that can help. The only way I could see someone finishing this level is with power ups which is very disappointing. Was good up until that particular level.

Cash grab, can't be beaten without spending a fortune on powerups. Everything revolves around making the player spend more and more money. This isn't gaming, this should be illegal. Games should be bought once, and them beaten without cheating algorithms. It also was falsely advertised that it's a puzzle game, instead what you get is a cascading game that could have been amazing without the need to pay to win mentality.

Very addictive too addictive did I mention it's addictive? just when you think you're going to stop you win an extra 30 minutes, 1 hour or 2 hours of play and you just keep going! Up to level 1000 now and you certainly don't need to spend money on the game unless you just must clear that level right now! story balances out the puzzles quite nicely.

This game is *not* as advertised. The adverts are way cooler but the game is wack. Plus, the way you have to spend coins is just too much. Don't listen to them say "it takes only a couple of tries to pass" because it doesn't. I played a level over 20 times but couldn't pass it until I used my coins. How can you be required to get 40 pieces each of the (scarce) yellow and blue items and then you're given only 18 tries? Obviously, all they're trying to do is make money out of their poor patrons.

I like the game. Its got a good concept but here's the thing. When you progress to higher levels the more money you have to spend and the levels are the same thing over and over again. Also, false advertisement. I sometimes see the ads which are like 'which one will save the girl? the tent or the clothes?' but the game is nothing like that. I'm probably going to uninstall.

The game is great until you get to the higher levels, then as usual you're set up to lose over and over and over again unless you pay for coins. And 900 coins for another life is way too high!! And to win 3 stars just to get 1 silly task done, gets boring after a while. Doing the rooms up is great but now each game takes forever, I've lost interest.

Its a cute game, but its target market is small kids. You play the same puzzle over and over. The ad said it's exactly as advertised. It's not, you have to play the jewel match game 90% of the time to add things to a home which takes up 5% of the time and only so now and then do you play other puzzles. I played it for almost an hour, had 2 puzzles other than jewel matching or deciding on decor. It's more like a Sims type vibe where you need to build a house other than play puzzles. Not for me.

Just another candy crush game where you can decorate a home in between levels... I downloaded the game because I was expecting to have a game where there will be multiple choice puzzles, to fix to things or save people etc. It looks very fun in advertisements. My question for the developers; you guys know that people like puzzle games not another CC game, and you advertising for it and when people download it, giving them something else. Why not just make a puzzle game and make people enjoy it?

"LOOKS ARE OFTEN DECEPTIVE". in the case of this game, this proverb proved to be true. They showed us a scene where the characters are fixing some household problems(the only reason I installed the game). But in reality it is just the copy of candy crush. 😡😡I played the game for a considerable time assuming that challenges will unlock at any certain level. But it never came. Such a disappointment I got. Literally, I am bored of this game.

I've been playing this game for 2 years and i found it good and fun at first...but this following months it kept on updating and now i can't play anymore... 'cause while I'm updating this game it only says that "an error occured, check your internet connection" but the signal is so strong! I hope this can be fix. I am really looking forward for your reply.

This is the most exciting puzzle game I've ever play. Yes, it's a hard game to beat but the key to beat the game is patience. I have reach more than a thousand level within a month of playing and never purchased any boosters or lives using my money. The downside of this game? using 900 coins to reffil lives, it's too much. When you beat a super hard levelbof this game and you decided to play GARDENSCAPES it will be easier to beat each level.

Yes, the "Hard" and "Super Hard" levels are harder and takes more time, but that makes this game more challenging and doesn't get tired about it!!! I cannot understand why people are giving low rate for making the game difficult! It's manageable without paying cash items!!!!! I highly recommend this game :)

This game is ridiculously expensive. Earning boosters and game cash occurs only with wins. When a puzzle is unbeatable without boosters, there are no other options other than to spend real money to get what's required to pass the level. Activating the clock on the infinity lives should be an option as well. Inevitably, I'll give up and most likely delete the app.

Not as much fun at higher levels (currently at 995) because it is so flipping hard. Spending a whole week stuck on a level isn't fun. Rewards are too small too. one special ticket for a level I had to play for days isn't good enough. Only thing that keeps me going is wanting to fix the house up. Too much time on the garage and side things. Let's get back to the house and leave the extras for later!

I love this game, but find it costs too many stars earned in the levels to complete the story missions. For example I'm renovating the library, and part of the story mission was to place 3 chairs. Each chair cost 3 stars to place, which took ages to pass enough levels to complete and didn't feel worth it. Most missions cost 3 or 4 stars to complete, which is a lot. It'd be better if it cost less stars each time, so playing the levels was more enjoyable instead of becoming a task in itself.

enjoyed the game at first but it is now very very slow. false advertisements too as it is not a fix or repair game by choosing the right tools. power boosts are a waste of time as they are put in the wrong places at the start of the game when there are limited moves anyway and they cost a lot of money. it is off putting too to see all the other rooms that you may get chance to decorate but at the moment I see it very unlikely anyone ever gets out of the first room. has the potential to be good.

This game is getting to be very mundane & repetitive. I refused to use real money to progress and will stop playing it if it constantly failed my efforts. I noticed after a few days of non playing, the game became easier to progress when one returns to it. When I first started, it was entertaining, now it is getting stale & yes, money grabbing which I refused to indulge in. Plenty more games out there to play for free.

This game was quite addictive. I enjoyed playing. However, some levels, you are set up to fail unless you purchase lives and boosters, I mean actually impossible. Most of the time it's switched off waiting for my 5 lives to replenish so I can play the same ridiculous level again and again. I appreciate that's how developers of these games make a living, but I'd take an ad over having to pay out. Why do you think I'm playing this instead of being out!?

NOT AS ADVERTISED!!! I have enjoyed playing this game for a couple of years now but am very concerned by the adverts I now see for it (when playing other games) and shocked to see the pictures on the app store have been changed to reflect the misleading adverts. This game is nothing like the adverts and pictures show it. I do still enjoy the game but anyone considering downloading should know they are not getting what they are being led to believe. Terrible business practice!!

I do have fun with the game, even if some of the levels are way too hard and get me stuck for weeks. It's the events I have a problem with. It takes massive amounts of energy to progress in them, an unrealistic amount, which makes it impossible to complete them. The merge minigame in particular frustrates me; I love merge games, but some of the items needed require me to max out an item, that generates me another item that I also have to max out! It's frustrating!

It's deceiving. I downloaded this game because of the mini games in between levels. But now the developers completely removed them mini games and made the game so difficult with lesser moves than the previous versions. Sucks! The hard and super hard levels should reward more stars. For example 2 stars for hard and 3 stars for super hard. But they don't! This gets frustrating. And why is this game needing more and more updates if it's only updated to frustrate us?!?!

Not as advertised. I downloaded the game after seeing the puzzle based ads for it. However whilst these ads mainly concentrate on the puzzles these actually form a very minor part of the game which is just moving coloured blocks. Persevered a little while but after reaching the second almost impossible moving blocks task gave up and uninstalled. On the plus side the advertising in game is nowhere near as intrusive as it has become for many games.

First, it's not cool that you have to force users to update the game? Not cool at all. This game is perfect, down to the gameplay, songs, and especially the story of this game. I wish there is more and MORE stuff added to this game. Maybe even a Homescapes 2? I love them all. Since I updated I can not play. It will not load and keeps crashing. Not only that, this game USE to be fun. Not anymore. When I first played this game, it was a pretty fun take on the match-3 formula with the story and renovation elements. But now that I came back to it today, I see it has been riddled with more and more unnecessary elements. A lot of them timed to keep you hooked or spend money to get the rewards and progress before the clock runs out. The wholesome atmosphere of restoration and friendship have been completely undermined by all the insidious, greedy practices this game implements.

One of the best game I've played but coins too expensive and stars given are too little for each level. It's almost impossible to pass the level when it gets higher. At the end u will need to keep purchasing. Don't mind if it's cheaper but just too expensive to purchase coins which will make ppl leave this game at the end of the day. 2 stars not rated due to this reason

Great game that soon gets addictive.. If it were simply for the Match-3 graphics, it would be a definite 5 star app. But the game is misleading in the advertisements and previews. If you're here after seeing the ads, there's nothing like it here. And the gameplay ; like a host of other players, I have been stuck at seemingly simple levels till I either ran out of time/lives /power features. 🙄 It invariably forces you to pay up for features after a few hundred levels

I've been enjoying this game and playing it for almost two years now. It's such a challenging game and entertaining as well. But I have a concern about this game, Homescapes! I'm currently at level 2741. And I saw a post of this person of her game, a screenshot. She's on level 2735. But she's more advance on renovating her boathouse! I'm just on Day 1 and she's on Day 3 already! How is that so? Please, fix this. That's just not fair. I'm really eager to move and renovate the next mansion! TY!

This game is not at all like the ads. Don't be misled by the "download" stats. A friend of mine likes the game a lot, and I thought the problem-solving ads looked great. But I was sadly disappointed. You will hardly ever see the problem solving games. For the rest, lots of ads and levels to struggle with took all the fun out of it.

I like the game and would love to give it stars, if only they'd also give more stars when completing hard levels. I like how there's a story line, however, some tasks need -4 stars to complete and you only get one star when finishing a level. It would be great if more stars were given for hard levels at least. I'd then give this game 5 stars. I also felt cheated, I used a power-up before the game started then the the game suddenly reshuffled since there were no moves available but my power-ups were no longer there 😥 so 2 two stars after that experience. Sorry

Just like all of the games from this dev, get ready to shell out bucks if you want to win. Almost every level needs multiple tries, bonuses, and in game purchases to win. Definitely your game if you want to be stuck on the same level for days/weeks, waiting for the auto-generated winning tile set. Also, the storyline is absurdly slow. Win a level to upgrade a single curtain or make one phonecall ??! Guys, come on. The concept and graphics are great, but the execution is a total fail.

I really love this game, I play it multiple times a day. It's relaxing and the compitiins are good but there are two downsides. 1) is the algorithm of the puzzles. I get an orange level (one chance), then the red (very hard), then the purple (hard) all in a row. I'd prefer an easy puzzle in between them. 2) I wish there were less meaningless tasks like spending stars on chatting to people and more on building.

Still playing this 2 years on so thought i'd better change my rating. Some levels are still very difficult and after a few days of being stuck the only way past is to buy powerups which can sometimes not help much anyway. Frustrating that the further you go through the game the more stars you need to complete simple tasks. Objective seems to be to slow down progress.

It was fun at first, but as you progress to higher levels, you would be stuck with hard levels, not just days, it would be weeks. I've been playing this before and even spend money here, but instead of fun, it gives anxiety and annoyance. Been giving this game a chance, but uninstalling it for the third time. DO NOT DOWNLOAD, WASTE OF TIME, AND NOT FUN AS YOU PROGRESS.

Love the graphics and effects. Always looking forward to unveiling the next level. Fun characters and beautiful designs. However, infinity time received gets wasted a lot just waiting for the end level to process. Why is there no skip like in Gardenscape? Levels are also much harder and frustrating, definitely makes me want to avoid this game on my good days. Also not as rewarding as the other game.

The game is fun and interesting, the gameplay is well made and I love the storyline. I would give it five stars except that the levels are simply to hard. When I need to play every level dozens of times its just not fun anymore. It would be a lot more satisfying to win the hard levels if some of the levels were easier but as it is I don't want to play anymore because it's not a challenge to win but just an endless annoying treck through the same level again and again.

Forget this stupid game, you are going to get to a point where levels are literally impossible to beat with or without boosts, I'd like to see the moron/s who design them beat the levels i am talking about, once you reach a certain point, hard and super hard levels come every 2nd or 3rd round and without spending money (of which i have spent thousands) you will not be able to progress. So prepare yourself for 10 minutes of game play and then days and weeks of frustration in between. Uninstalled!

Misleading advertisement. I am not happy about that. The storyline and art is cute and designs beautiful. Gameplay is enjoyable. Well done on that. However, as you progress, it becomes next to impossible to complete. I suggest more than one star for the level difficulty. I also suggest you change your advertisement.

The game itself isn't so bad, even if it's kind of babyish by nature. What's INFURIATING is how purposely difficult it is. They make doing the most simple tasks EXTREMELY difficult, because they want you to buy coins, so you can actually progress, and this is from the get go! There's literally no difficulty curve! If you don't enjoy games that stress you out, AVOID this game!

costs in game are so high that by the time you get to a decent level you have to be either very good, (which I'm not!) or purchase coins, which I won't. started off enjoying this but will be deleting shortly. the 'speech' bits go on a bit too long too, I just wanted to play the levels.

Firstly, not the same as the ad(reason i downloaded it).... in the ad you fix things with tools etc. Secondly, some of the "easy" levels, as you go along, get way harder then the hard ones.. incredibly frustrating. Thirdly, not enough reward for the very hard ones... also takes way too long to get a heart and asking way too much for extra moves..... deleted game

After months of playing, the game just wiped all my progress. I'm literally back at the beginning. I've tried everything to get back my lost progress but nothing works. This is the second time my progress has just been removed. I normally save progress all the time but not it's not working. I was playing and the game just froze and then popped back into the green "play" button and when I tapped I was at the beginning. I'm genuinely so sad. Will never use this or any of its similar games again.

Game is impossible to play or win without constantly pumping money into it, I downloaded it because of a Facebook add and it has nothing to do with that, this is just a simple matching game, nothing else and even for that is a bad one, the right pieces never come together in the right time and place, so the game constantly asking for 900 gold for 5 more steps and even than its not enough, just keep paying and paying and paying, this is just a rip off, do not download it

Waste of time game. Don't go by the ads you see in other games. Terrible strategy to attract customers. Actual game is just a match 3 game that gets too tough quickly. The company itself promotes its games a lot through false advertising showing someother game with this name. That is a very cheap way. Please ensure that your ads atleast show something related to actual gameplay.

Good match 3 game, challenging but never impossible obstacles. Nice story arc. The only disapointment is that the adds had led me to believe there were room disaster/repair puzzles, and I've seen none. Lost a second star for lack of response to their marketing adds. EDIT: Yeah, the adds are pretty much all lies, now. Too bad they hate players.

I think the difficulty of the levels makes me wanna give up playing... it takes me too long to get one star and now I need 3 to complete one task! And another star to start a new day... that should be free. But I love the gameplay and graphics, they're awesome. I'm gonna try one more day, if I can't get my stars, uninstall... 😋 [Edit: 2 years went by and I'm still playing!]

Overall I am enjoying this game, however I think it should give more stars after each level you beat one 🌟 at a time doesn't seem fair considering you need one or more to do a task. That's really the only frustrating thing about the game. And I might add I am pretty sure the game cheats because when its supposed to help me when I use my rockets...bombs ...planes ect it doesnt take away things to help and also I am getting super hard levels quite frequent

Definitely prefer this game to its predecessor gardenscapes. The new power ups are great and there is an interesting story line. Yet some of the levels are to hard to beat sometimes and it gets boring to keep doing them. This is especially bad if i have uninstalled the game and then later on reinstalling it hoping that there would be a chance for me to restart it. Yet i still love the idea of it and all the graffics.

It's fun but the fact you run out of lives so fast is annoying, then you have to wait for half an hour. But the levels are just chance really, and then you don't even get to keep all the coins; they go into a 'safe' which you can pay £5 to open so that's annoying. The renovating the mansion is fun though.

Like all pay-to-progress games, this starts out fun and fair, but as you get higher in level the game gets much harder and less likely to progress unless you rope in friends and/or pay for "coins". Becomes quite frustrating, and I can see why only a minority of players seem to keep on. And now it's deleted my progress and started over from level 1... I'm done.

There are levels called super hard on here where if you don't get the right draw you will always lose unless you spend real money or get really lucky. With a limited amount of lives doing these levels can take days to do and has caused me to quit the game. It's no fun when your stuck on a level for days because you have to wait for your life count to replenish or pay to have it replenished.

Hi Homescapes! I am a fan of Austin, the story and the game itself. I love how creative the team and hardwork in putting effort for a good game experience. BUT I have few feedback, there is no difference between Hard and Super Hard level, as both is impossible to surpass. This is also the same cliche comments of other players. The levels are supposed to be challenging, but not in the way that we will spend extra money for it. I will give you five stars if you hear out all this from us. Thanks

I love the game. BUT I do not see the point of making the game "harder" or "very hard"... They get too difficult. I agree on this with others that have criticised this because they are right. The fun is gone when the game becomes so difficult that you get stuck on the same level for weeks! There is a point I collect the tokens because its impossible to pass the level I'm stuck on!

While I like this game for it's visual quality and narrative structure, I find myself questioning why some levels are unreasonable hard. You'll spend money purchasing coins only to lose it in one shot. To me this is kinda ripping players off. The first paragraph review I wrote a while back. Today the same issue is repeating itself. Some levels are unreasonably hard. The moved they give you are not enough yet the challenge requires you to fill more tasks. It makes the game boring and redundant.

It was an amazing game but Financial model became horrendous. Levels are now so random that you, most of the time, can't finish even the 'easy ones' without either a stroke of huge luck, using boosters (which strangely seems to increase the chances of combos), using in game items or paying for additional moves (btw button made to press it by error) Events are just there to make you use your gold by error on the dynamites. I have only recently started this game and definetly enjoying it, love how it's not like every other match game out there. The levels are quite engaging and wanting me to play more and more. Decent time-killer. In terms of gameplay I like Gardenscapes more but because I prefer indoor decorating I've been busy playing this recently. Homescapes has too much animation, I just want to press the arrow and move to the next level, not watch my rewards do a flashy animation. Story wise it's pretty meh because there's not much going on unless you're really chill (thanks skip button!) Graphics are okay. Animations could use a bit of work and needs to be cut short.

One flaw is that sometimes you can be stuck on a level for days or more, so you either need a lot of patience or you will need to spend real money to progress, and coins are not cheap to buy. Also, do not believe the advertising campaigns, they don't reflect the actual gameplay. The ads where you seem to have to choose the right tools to do a job? Never happens. It's false advertising!

The game is good, relaxing, however, some of the levels take two to three days to get over. Once I was stuck on a level for a week n even stopped playing the game. I'm playing nowadays, but the issue is there. Levels need not be so time consuming. Also, the power ups are limited and expensive. The amount of coins given per level is too less, hard levels should reward two stars.

Level 4522 I'm soo frustrated when it has only one item left that needed to get and I always short of moves, I used an hour of free games and 5 times of having a loaded life span not to mention bombs but still I can't able to get out of this F level. You think this is funny?! No it's not...the fact that it was more than 3 times that I almost got it and that 1,yes only 1 item was always left... I'M SOOOO GRRRRRRRHHHHH .....

I'm dropping my rating from 5 stars bc the game's quality has declined for me. I've been a loyal player for over 5 years, and I loved the mini-games and the extra energy system you used to have. However, the recent changes have made the game much harder to enjoy. The new system is frustrating, and it feels like I can no longer progress like I used to. I hope the devs see this review and consider bringing back some old stuff.

To be honest, there are so many levels that are so, but SOOOO difficult that it might take you days, MANY days to solve a level... But sometimes isn't fear -.- 😑 I like it and I will recommend it, tho the difficulty is something that can be adjust (more moves at least for the levels.. Just a little more 🤔😅)

Criticizing the game won't help you to pass the puzzle levels, the game developer didn't force you to download and play their game, they also didn't told you to buy power ups to win a level.. it just shows that you're not thinking enough on your every moves..I've been playing for a while now, and I'm at level 325, I reached this level without buying any power ups.. and somwhat, it's a bonding game between my husband and I..

This is definitely an addictive sort of game but its designed to make you want/have to make purchases with actual money. The amount of coins you get for completion of tasks is a joke. That said, the prices on extras do seem a little more reasonable than some games but not as good as others. The decoration items are boring as hell and the storyline is as cheesy as it gets; I rarely upgrade rooms as I'd rather complete the puzzles then have to skip loads of tesious dialogue.

It was fun at first but when you reach a higher level like lvl 64, the matching task is near impossible to take. Maybe i am just missing something but i think this game is not for me. I decided to uninstall it before i start hating it. Thanks

I've noticed there is no longer the option to watch ads for coins. Another addictive match-3 game that is sometimes stupidly "difficult" for no reason, and highly dependant on boosters or luck to play. There's no much strategy to it, you just hope you get good matches until the game makes you think you are good at it. The visuals are really pleasing tho (but the characters are weird, have creepy smiles and they love to clap all the time.. so dumb)

Constantly my game progress disapears and game returns me to level 1. I've been playing for years, got to level 2755 and was restoring relaxation room when puff... All gone!!!! This needs to be fixed somehow urgently, it keeps happening more and more often.

This game is similar to Candy Crush. To perform a task, you need star and to get the star, you need to play the mini game similar to Candy Crush. And here I tought, I'll be playing some puzzle game as the game goal is ti fix the house. The repeated style of mini game is boring and sometimes, it quite difficult. If the game, use other style of minigame, it will be better.

The wait-to-bonus for non paying is fair in this game! I rated 1 star because of poor mechanics. Some "normal" levels are harder than "hard" or "ultra hard" levels. Airplane bonuses are useless, since their priority is random (ex: you want the cat to be hit first, since those can only be broken with bonus from combos). In a sentence, if you are not a machine, you cannot beat this game and it will only bring more frustration. Bugs present as well. Pay coins for life and you don't get them...

Edited: About a year after my review I decided to give it a chance again because I did like the game. I was very pleased to see they implemented the games they advertised as little bonus games. They are now honoring what they advertise. False ads lured me in. I liked the game so I stayed. But I've been seeing so many of their false ads that I left the game. It's a good game, and I did love it. I just got annoyed.

I enjoy the game and decorating the house. Enjoyed William's study but wish I could have finished it and been able to see it later. Not liking some of the really hard levels. Days spent on one level means you can't move forward. It's the reason I deleted the game previously. Absolutely loved the team helping time. Only way I got past a couple of levels. I got started on the game again and while I keep moving forward and seeing the house, I will keep playing.

started great, but the I got stuck on level 54 with nothing, been trying it for two days now with no luck all they want is for me to spend money to buy coins. Its a money pit. Thats not what I signed for.

Under normal circumstances, I would give this game a five star, considering the aesthetics of the house design and the entertainment the puzzle game gives; however, I just want to put a finger down because there are so many levels that are so hard to beat, even with power ups. The problem rests from the number of moves you give. It's unreasonable and annoying. Moreover, it would probably be nicer if the stars given for hard and super hard levels are two and three stars, so to balance the game.

Fantastic addictive game I just wish the cat bonus levels were a bit easier, it's impossible to reach the end. also some of the levels are very hard and take ages to complete, then as soon as you do complete it the next level is specified as hard or super hard. there is no difference between normal and hard levels. Just my opinion though

It was a great game but please as level keep on rising please dont be so greedy in put more moves to swap the block. Like the game. Graphics are surprising detailed for a mobile game. Lots of nice choices for decorating. I also think the coin cost of 5 extra moves should be less than obtaining a set of full lives. It can also be tedious waiting so long to gain enough stars to complete tasks - especially the ones which have say 3 parts to complete @ 3 stars each.

I love this game and I've been playing this for years ❤️ but its getting annoying because you have to buy certain things/deals just to have those special upgrades like the dog. Also, i always saw your ads for homescapes and its not like the actual game. Hope you can give us good deals without speding money like we could just watch ads or something.

Some levels are very difficult to get by without power-ups. Five lives are very minimal to work with. As for the start of the day requiring a star, I found it to be such a waste. In the end it eventually becomes a bore since this game requires more candy-crush-like leveling up rather than homescaping as it's name falsely suggests.

Not a bad game.. just started playing it. I normally wait longer to write a review but it's not as advertised... I downloaded this game because the advertisement video looked like a puzzle game. When I began playing it.. it was actually like tetris type mini games to earn revenue to put toward fixing the house... requires money or time to level up.. I will keep playing it just isnt as advertised..

Redefine difficulty. The hard levels are mostly easy and the easy ones are mostly hard. I get stuck longer at an easy level than in hard ones. Plus earning stars is sooo hard. I mean one star per level?? I wonder how long ill be able to play this. Id probably stop at level 300. And that's around 20 or so levels away. Its just too tedious to get all the work done at the house. Stars are soo difficult to earn.

Would have loved this game if only the levels are achievable. It's a great game that has been ruined by greed for money. In app purchases should be optional - a nice thing to have or a requirement every now and then - not a necessity for doing every little thing. I'm not even that far into the the game and it's become impossible to advance without throwing money into it to buy additional moves or special objects the cost of which are exorbitant. What you get for your money is not worth it at all.

Good game but quite few flaws. The biggest of them is the fact that this game relies too much on pure luck. There are levels that even with few boosters you can't complete for hours and even days, and then out of nowhere you complete it in few moves without any boosters. To me this game looks pre-conditioned the way that it frustrates you with not being able to complete the level, so you buy stuff for real money to help you get through. If you don't do it, then eventually it will let you pass

Love this game, being able to now be part of a team is a fab idea. Only complaints are 1. it costs so many coins to get 5 more goes on a level, 900 for the first 5 then 1200 etc. it's not easy to get coins for free and some levels really are just impossible without having more goes or added boosters 2. why does it need to cost 2/3 stars to do any of the tasks. EIn my opinion either coins should be easier to get or tasks should cost less stars.

It resets the entire game at random and won't give back your progress no matter what evidence you have of your work. I lost months of work to this issue twice. I'm not willing to do it all again. Also game play is not as advertised and there are often glitches in the game levels meaning you don't always get the stars earned in each level to complete design tasks.

Just after a recent update. I have not been able to play the game. Saying internet too slow. I have tried wifi, and data. Tried shutting down my phone. The game was working fine before the update. Been days unable to play while my husband can.

It's a good game and very addictive. Unfortunately you are only given 5 lives and most of the time they get used up very fast. Even on the most thought out and strategically played levels you find yourself using most your turns on pointless moves that are far away from your objective. Eventually there are no moves on the board and it needs to reshuffle. By this point you are unable to complete the level. If they could find a way to get better rng the game would be a perfect 5 star

Not the game advertised or expected. It's a candy-crush style match game, with the veneer of renovating a house against the owners wishes. Not worth it at all. The games/puzzles in the adverts? They are very very quick mini games once every 5 match games, and they're over so quick as to be pointless with no challenge or thought required. Disappointing at best.

This game was nice in the beginning. Later, they were missing a lack of "new levels" and let us play on old ones. Where we don't get no stars rewards. So in that case all building procesare stopped. I have more complains but game administrators don't care about it so 🤷‍♀️ it is how it is. 🤷

Spend Spend Spend! Good graphics and all that but just like every other rip off game on play, If you want to really get ahead your gonna spend a minimum of $50.00. Good right in the beginning but then it starts to take rediculous amounts of time to get through a level while you are hounded to buy more lives. If you like clutter then you will love this game. You'll be given the chance to completely ruin some lovely places with an endless supply of tacky stuff. So if you're a minimalist, I'd stay away as it is quite painful to be forced to cram yet another unnecessary piece of furniture into an already packed room. As for the match 3 element of the game, it's the same as all other versions of that concept.

Play Store is not letting me update the app. I click Update, it loads all the way up until the loading circle is complete... then tells me it is unable to update. Could be great game, but most levels are too hard. Almost impossible. We have a lot stress in everyday life, and games are supposed to relax us, not add stress. Not happy!! They are basically trying to force me into in app purchases as I can't get passed level 60. Really awesome game till you reach the "impossible level". E.g. clean the whole field of 50 items with 10 hard breaking boxes using only 5 moves. Good game, basically candy crush but better. Adverts are very misleading but u end up liking the game nonetheless. Some levels are IMPOSSIBLE to beat unless u use extra money to get more moves or use powerups, which is kind of annoying cause you'll basically need luck to win them. I downloaded the game after seeing an advertisement. The game is nothing like I expected. It's interesting though, and addictive. However, winning a level should give you more than 1 star. The game will actively stop you from completing levels during events with a variable RNG algorithm which will control your likelihood of completing anything. If you are stuck, you are stuck. You spend 5 minutes and then wait two and a half hours waiting for them to replenish, often for days sometimes weeks on certain super hard levels until it won't, so this is not suitable for passing the time.

I downloaded this game because the ad made me believe it was something else. The ad showed me a wrecked room with various tools/options to fix it. (Ex: fire extinguisher to put out a fire). But no.
