perfect for a bit of time wasting and building and replacing items in the house extremely enjoyable, however the gameplay itself can be frantically frustrating and annoying I would not recommend this game for anyone that is easily annoyed. note for developer the game can be better if the progress can be rolled on the next game e.g. if you are collecting two different items and you collect one sets before you run out of moves then you should not have worry about them in the next try.

EDIT : The game has improved so much and I am so glad I didn't uninstall it. All the stuff I said below don't apply it was right around the time when the game first came out. Thank you so much for all the work you've put into this!! ***Very old review*** At first it was very fun to play the games, earn stars and get renovations done but why are the levels so hard ?! I struggled to get to level 54 with powerups and I can't go on anymore. I've been stuck here for days and am starting to seriously lose interest in this game. Here is a suggestion : what about adding the feature that more moves be added FOR FREE after you lose in a level more that 5 times (or even 10 just add more moves). Playing the game while knowing that it's fine to lose because it'll get easier each time will make the game much more exciting to play. But when there's no way out it just gets boring and you end up unninstalling the game. There are tons of games on play store and this game could easily be replaced because of how hard it gets from the start.

At first I loved the game but it became quickly apparent that it takes FOREVER to advance. I'm on level 760 and yeah, the kitchen/foyer is done, the orangery and most of the living room, but it feels like I've barely scratched the surface of the game. I'd love to "finish" Homescapes at some point but at every turn it takes 3 stars to do the tiniest little task. It's a little annoying. I really like the story line, but it takes so long to move forward that I'm getting bored. I'd love it if players could actually finish the game. Remember when you could actually do that? Give your loyal players something really satisfying like that, and we'll look forward to the next game that Playrix releases! I'd also consider starting the game over to play a second time through and choose different designs. But I've been playing many months now every evening. I'm losing interest. Snoozing here.... Ps I like the Halloween update!

Like any game, there are winning set ups and losing set ups. It can be challenging, but just go slow, pay attention, and you can get lucky and win. I'm up over L1900 now. I've won a couple tournaments. I'd like to think skill has some relevance, but it's clear that some games hand you the win. [Edit] I have noticed too many levels that have a required target, reliant upon a drop rate, that drops less than the number of moves given, effectively sabotaging your game. 👎

The game literally screams out pay 2 win. It's easy for the first couple rounds and after that it gets insanely hard basically pushing you to spend money on the game to advance or spend 20 years on one level to complete it. The new update may seem like it was made to make it easier for you. It's a lie. Just more pay 2 win stuff.

Very annoying match-3 puzzle game. Very few useless boosts which costs a lot. Too many hard levels, each 5 or 10 - is very hard, that will take you 2-3 fays to beat or spend a lot of coins. Story is really streched with stupid actions like "open box", "put item of the box on the table" and "tell mom you did it" - each of which requires you to spend star (equivalent of one level to beat). Graphics is really cool.

I like the game but as other people have said the levels get hard very quickly and you can be stuck on a level for days! UPDATE (06/23) You have to get used to the algorithms to get through some levels but you can eventually. If you use real money, the prices have increased massively for far less coins or bonuses. It's impossible to get through the merge or map games without spending a lot of real money. Shame they stopped the seasons where you won new decorations for the house.

I love this game! I've been playing for a while but the levels are getting harder and the number of stars needed for each take is also increasing. I feel that the hard levels should be worth 2 stars because I play for hours sometimes even weeks and barely make any progress and it's very frustrating. And there are some tasks that aren't of any progress towards the house. I'm also really irritated by all the false adverts Don't like supporting a game that uses trickery to attract players

I love the play and the story behind... but I noticed a pattern. I'll have a hand full of easy levels, then I get stuck and when I get stuck, I am fairly consistently 1 turn away from reaching my goal... It's very suspicious and very frustrating. When I use my power ups... They typically don't help all that much at the start of the level. I will play a bit more, but I don't see myself playing into the 3 digit levels.

Decided to change my review. Been playing this game for the past 4 years. On my way to level 3000. But for the past few months this game has become more of a pain, than a relaxing time. You win one level, just to get stuck on the next level for nearly 6days. Unless you keep buying stuff to cheat your way through the levels. Why bother buying a Golden Ticket if you rearly get pass the 20 level of it, I never seem to finish a remodel and or a season. Disgusted, dissapointed,

Was initially good, but now through the advanced stages, it tends to cheat! Double balls suppose to clear all screen, no it doesn't, ball and another power up is suppose to give you a screen full of powerups, no it does not, and if you are almost finished, need on more item, and heaps of moves left, none of the required items come down, in one case, they all disappeared from the screen! Extermely disppointing. Argh

I used to really really like this game in the beginning when acheiving goals was actually acheivable. Now at a much higher level it is essentially a pay-to-win game. Progress is super slow, levels are hard to beat and rewards are small compared to the amount of time, money and power-ups you will end up using just to complete a task. For completing a level you get maybe 90 points but to add life you spend a minimum 900 points. Ridiculous!!

Up till level 60 something and it's already hard for me. I wonder how hard the next levels are. This game is very addicting and I love the graphics. But the super hard levels makes me lose motivation. Edit: I uninstalled this game for 2 years and reinstall it this year, this game improves a lot than before. The levels are hard, but when u do solve them, u just felt a sense of accomplishment. I just wish we could share boosters for the hard lvl between our team mates aside from sharing lives.

The levels are too difficult....I spend tens of hearts to go over some levels...It's annoying and it makes me hate the game. It should be relaxing but it's not, it makes me crazy. Don't get me wrong, I love the graphics and Austin and his family and the house and the many options to choose from in the house. Please make the levels more doable! I had it installed before and erased it because it annoyed me to death. I reinstalled it and I rediscovered why I started to hate it....

New review: I have realised the following: 1. I played more than 4200 levels, the levels are now almost impossible and no longer fun to play. 2. I buy coins when I like a level, but suspect the programming is not random. If you buy once, it feels like you cannot beat levels without byuing again. 3. Weekends seem to have the algorithms set tougher than the week. For two weeks I have made no payments and have sat for 4-5 days with one level until Monday. Then winning is easy. I give up, I go!

This game ranges from the ridiculous to outright face bitingly impossible... some of the levels are so easy you finish with half your moves left. While some of the 'hard' levels are designed in such a way your starting boosters become irrelevant, and you only pass the level when the game almost does it for you. I have spent weeks on some of the harder levels. i have now decided to walk away. it was fun for a while, but not now that it feels like a chore...

It's too difficult. the lives and hours spend to beat enough levels to do a very small thing in the house/garden is just too much. I'm at level 387 and think about quiting when I finished the first garden part. 3 stars for each thing needed to be done. overdecorating the place which makes it less beautiful is also something I don't really like. there should be an option to leave some spaces empty. The kitchen is full of flowers and color and it doesn't fit the way I decorated it and it also doesn't fit in a kitchen... better leave the van with flowers out of the game since it makes it less beautiful and it's not relevant to the game which should be going about renovsting a place and not living a butlers life. I do like the halloween event now. but again, make the levels easier to beat! that's really the pain in the ass. Or leave them this difficult but reduce the price to do something. I had loved to see the full renovated house. but I guess I'll search google images to watch the full renovated house and quit playing since the progress is way too slow.

Really enjoyed this game at first. But as others have said, too many stars are required to do many of the tasks. For example, the tasks required to complete a cake cost something like 15 stars! When it can literally take days to get past a really difficult level, that makes for pretty slow progression. It just stopped being fun honestly, I'm down for a challenge but this game eventually just got too hard/slow for me to bother with.

Not as satisfying as other similar games. A lot of limitations within the game as you progress (moves, boosters capabilities, lives, etc) so you dont have flexibility to play for a long time at once or benefit from rewards because you have to use them at the beginning if the game when blocks are locked/missing and less useful. Lack of autonomy in the game is meant to get you to buy coins so you can just enjoy the game. You are also unable to turn off story mode, so forced to spend time skipping.

You've played this game a thousand times before. The gameplay is another Candy Crush clone. Gimmick is you earn stars which in turn do stuff to your house. The difficulty curve is all over the place, regardless of level. I am at level 800 and even now I can fly through 10-20 levels within half an hour then be stuck on a 'normal' level for a week. Luck plays a HUGE if not CORE part rather than skill, unfortunately, which pushes played to buy the in-app items which at its basis: is a scam.

I thought this would be fun, but when you complete a game you are only rewarded 50 coins plus extra coins - max you can get is 100+ sometimes 😁 If you need to buy more moves though it costs 900 coins and then more & more coins if you only have 1 or 2 things to achieve - where is the logic in that? You are not rewarded accordingly to gain the stars you need to help renovate. This is pretty much a money sucking game which I'm pretty much over. And the tasks I'm finding are just meaningless. Sorry

Enjoyed it in the early stages, then you get to level 30 where you have 22 moves to collect 80 tiles of a nominated colour (which you get by swapping adjacent tiles to make a matching row of 3). Its next to impossible to complete. I'm sure it suddenly becomes possible though if you buy into the "aw no, did you fail? No problem! buy more lives!!" like it asks. Really annoyed me!!!

I really enjoyed this game. However, the game wasn't same as what the ads showed to me. In the ads, they showed about if your house is in fire, you have to choose thing to put out the fire but the game doesn't even same. It was a game where you can play a match game and sometimes I took for 2 hours just to complete one level. I mean..it was good but doesn't if the level keep being difficult. Please help. This game should be fun not make peoples been stressing. 😫😫😫😕

I forgot why I uninstall the game at the first time. The game was so cute. The image, the doll, the story.. So why did I uninstalled it? So I reinstalled the game and gave it a second chance. Ohh! I remember now. The higher level was ridiculously hard to pass even after your tenth time! You could not pass the level without using the bonus. (Only if you have some) If you don't have then you will have to spend money. Imagine if almost all level required you to do that. You'll be poor🤷‍♀️🤦‍♀️

Too difficult. The levels have got ridiculously hard. You only get one star reward and have to spend it on stupid tasks. Look at the cat, stroke the cat, feed the cat etc. It is a house decorating game. At times the bombs don't create as much damage obviously on purpose so you lose and have to spend money to proceed. If you need one red block to win after 6 moves no red blocks come.100% CHEATS FOR SURE. It has quite nice graphics but otherwise has become too stressful for me. I will DELETE.

The game is good, the match 3 and home decorating elements are good but they make it too hard. There are levels that you need to buy things to get past or you just stay stuck on them, and they make the decorating elements cost more so to do something basic can be multiple stars. They also add in a ton of non decorating tasks that you can't ignore or other tasks won't generate. I wound up deleting after spending all my 'money' and power ups and still failing a level because I didn't buy.

Fun game, but once you reach level 50, it feels as though you need to pay to win. The double chains makes it hard to finish the level within the given number of moves. There was the occasional 'side-game' that popped up to give a bit of diversity, but I'd like it if there were more of it. I didn't enjoy the pacing of the story all that much, because we needed stars for every action. It disrupted the flow and you stop caring at some point, because you're concentrating on beating the game levels.

I really like this game bur I hate how many stars you have to earn to fix something. The other thing I notice is that in the higher levels (1600 and higher) they don't give you as many moves to finish the level which I find very frustrating. I really enjoy playing this game but haven't lately because of how much harder they have made it to go up each level. Sometimes the only way you can advance is to purchase coins to buy extra moves. Not haply about that!

It passes time when you're lazy feeling. But good luck using any strategy at all in these games. They suck really bad. It's all computer generated if the computer wants you to win then you will if it doesn't then you won't. You literally have better odds winning at the casino then on one of these levels. They will let you play until they have your data patterns then watch out. They should just have a simulation button for each level see if you win or loose. Make a purchase and see what happens

I downloaded this after watching an ad for it and it was nothing like the ad. Very frustrating. Levels were also very difficult had to delete it after I couldn't do one of the levels. Played the same levels for 6 weeks without luck and used all the boosters, I would go and play pretty much as soon as lives regenerated. Also wish I could do both homescapes and gardenscapes in the same game. It would also be nice to have customisable features even if you had to pay with in game coins.

The game is really fun. I seriously play it with my friends. But i think the time where you change the reward of super hard levels from 2 stars to coins are just making the game more time consuming, add up the hard levels. I wish you add more customizable options like for the characters and items that makes the game user-friendly. Overall good game

I really like this game, just a little complain... When we received, said 30min unlimited hearts, could you create a way where we can choose when to use it!? Even if you give them with a expired time, most of the time I just want to try a difficult stage and when I win it I don't have time to keep playing. Not to mention the 3 hours... I really envy the person who can play the same game for 3 hours... Still it's a fun game. Thanks

I used to love this game but now I don't even see the point to playing anymore. Hard levels are really impossible, and when we are stuck we lose a lot of the special events rewards. It's not even fun anymore. And the planes changed. And when there are many boards on same lvl, all the added up boosters get lost. Which make it even more impossible to pass. I am stuck at lvl 106 and am thinking more about uninstalling the game. No fun anymore.

I like the graphics, and characters. I like unravelling the storyline as I go. I enjoy the puzzles. The fact that they are difficult can be frustrating, however, it is all the more rewarding when that level is completed. I like all of the rewards the game gives you. Sometimes it is difficult to beat events before they are over, though I enjoy playing them while they last. The controls are easy, the puzzles are fun. I like seeing all the different design combinations for the mansion as well.

It was alright at first. But once you hit level 65+ it takes too much to beat the level (one level required all my powerups, plus bonus ones and still wasn't enough) and progress. Also being on level 75, I expected to have more puzzles that are in the avatar, but I have done 4 of them. Downloaded it to play those puzzles, not connect 3 the whole time (which is alright if mixed properly).

Graphics, storyline and game play are excellent. However it frustrates me instead of relaxing me. TOO few moves! Let me say that again, TOO few moves! Having a great game and not allowing the player to enjoy the game is a pity. Where is the relaxed mode? Why not have the challenges with a small number of moves and the main game in a more relaxed pace? A real pity for all the great artwork the game has to demonstrate.

The game has become way too reliant on paying to win! Levels got very hard and take days or sometimes weeks to complete and having back to back super hard levels really doesn't make the game fun anymore. I Cound a total of 7 back to back super hard levels with a break of just 1 regular level then back to superhard. Many of us have noticed a huge decline in moves that don't work for the actual level. Fewer moves than you need to remove obstacles and complete other tasks. It's not fun anymore!

A great game I've enjoyed for years. But the devs implemented many changes that reduced the gameplay to a luck-based puzzle where every other level is hard or very hard so you pay money for coins to get power ups - which oftentimes don't help. I despise the alarm clock obstacle that ends the game. It'd be better if there were only 1-2 clocks on the board at a time instead of 5+ clocks with only 6 moves left on them all. It's all money-grab techniques.

Level of difficulty increases rapidly, more so than similar genre type games. They go right to the sales pitch and theres absolutely no getting by a level if you dont purchase. Experienced CC, Bejeweled etc player and was looking for a new game. Repeatedly stumped by level 40 puzzles and stuck on the same one for days now. Taking the app of my device. I'll find another game to give my money to. Don't waste your time.

Annoying. Just got 14 levels first go in a row, with all the extras plus flints extras and I can't get through this level because of the bubbles. They are so rapid and you rarely get matches next to them. Even using coins to get extra moves it's practically impossible unless you use real money... had this problem throughout but this time is really annoying. Couldn't of have any extra help and still can't pass?????? The anger is real.

Good game but frustrating. If you run out of attempts on the game and have no stars you cant play it other than buy coins, which I did. However purchasing coins doesn't guarantee you will get to the next level so the money is wasted. It stops you from playing for 30 mins. You then get one attempt. If you fail again you have to wait another 30 mins and so on. Ridiculous concept. The idea of a game is to play when you wish not when the app dictates.

I like the game (although the storyline is a bit twee). However, pieces on the gameboard keep flashing/moving to indicate where to make a booster, or 3 in a row. It's distracting, and makes it difficult to create the booster you actually need. Sometimes it doesn't respond to your touch unless you do what it's suggesting. *Edit - I'm on level 1525 which is, not just difficult but, impossible to beat without an extraordinary amount of luck. So uninstalling. Been fun up until now.

The game gets frustratingly random at later levels. The difficulty, combined with random nature of gameplay, will anger you. The competitive events are unfair for people who are at later levels, which are sometimes borderline impossible to do on first try without boosters. I often find myself doing moves that are meaningless to progress of level because I simply can't do anything else. Combine that with 5 lives and you are done within 30minutes.

First: It is nothing like the ads show, false marketing! It is initially a great game, but around level 24-28 it becomes a "pay to win" money pit game. It feels absolutely impossible to complete the levels without boosters or additional lives - that, realistically, you can only buy for real money. When you keep trying to solve the very same level 10, 20, 30 times without even being close to the goal your frustration grows and just stop playing it altogether...

Don't get me wrong.. I love the game. It's my go-to game "whenever" I'm frustrated and want something to clear my head with and it works! But there are some glitches. The few moves that are given in difficult levels is so frustrating. After accumulating a reasonable amount of coins hoping to make a purchase for some boosters you're forced to use them to continue the unfinished level. And don't even get me started on the expeditions. They are always impossible to complete. But I love the game

Would have given this game 5 stars considering how addictive it is but the levels are too difficult to please do something about it please. How can I be stuck in a particular level for almost five days?? Please iñcrease the stars per level because sometimes I forget I'm supposed to renovate the house. Also increase the money at the end of the game. How can I use alot of boosters during the game and at the end I don't even get up to 100 or even 80???? It's so annoying . Please fix it🙏🙏🙏

Pretty cool game. Gets VERY challenging and difficult after a little. Not that there's anything wrong with that, I'm just sayin. But I thought that most of the game would be decorating and choosing interior, but apparently I was (very) wrong... It relies heavily on match 3. So if you're into that, you're gonna like this game. It has a cool twist of decorating.

this is an excellent match 3 game with interesting powerups, fun gameplay, and bright colours. so why am i rating this so poorly? predatory microtransactions. the game seems to cheat after a certain point. sure, you can fairly easily get to level 300 or so, but at that point you will often find you can't progress any further without using boosters on EVERY stage, even the "normal" ones. you just don't have enough moves or moves get wasted, unless you pay money. then it's mysteriously easy again!

The drawback –as per usual– is the monetization/push to pay for progress; which is typical for these kind kf FTP games. Once you hit level 50+ the puzzles are practically impossible to beat without powerups. Other than that— well done, fun to play, and the different options for furnishings are nice. The mini-games are fun, and add a nice break from the usual match puzzles. It would be cool if those popped up a bit more frequently.

A shame really. The game is actually pretty decent, like a better version of candy crush. However, the good parts are unfortunately tainted by: 1. false advertising of some multiple choice puzzle game (don't even understand why, since the actual game is nice) 2. Not skill based, rigged levels. The supposed "difficulties" are nonsense and completely arbitrary. Many combo matches often gets ignored by the game, based on presumably some algorithm that only let's you win if you lose 50 times.

This game starts off at a high difficulty and fails to keep the player's interest. Rewards for passing a level are too low, tasks require too many points. Not to mention this game's marketing campaign is too aggressive and the false advertising is irritating. I played this game last year and uninstalled it already, I'm tired of seeing dozens of ads for this game in every single app I use, especially when the ads don't even match the actual gameplay.

I installed this game based on ads for it in other apps. Those ads are super misleading! This is not about making choices to prevent catastrophes, as the ads suggest, it's just shape matching to get points, which can then be traded for furniture and renovations. Addictive enough that I played for awhile, but not at all what I expected.

When you get to a certain level the paper plans if you need them never help you, infact they do the opposite and you will loose so that can be very frustrating and you cant get off that level. So for that reason i cant give 5 stars. Some levels are very good but when you get a bad one then it can take over a week to try get through it and that can make you want to uninstall it x

I liked the game, but some of the levels are too hard and to tell you of an example I've been trying to pass a super hard level for over 3 months now!! I know it's a super hard level but that a little too hard!! just wish was how was in the beginning with no hard or super hard level its ridiculous. I'm just going to uninstall as found other games that are easier and more enjoyable to play then this. took the fun out of it now.

Homescapes, how do I hate thee, let me count the ways... 1. The monetization is very aggressive. You truly cannot play or enjoy this game without frequent double-digit payments. 2. The "mini-games" you see in the ads are few and far between, and the renovation elements are stifled by the constant need to pay match-3 games. 3. The match-3 games are INSANELY HARD. 4. The money I did spend was wasted because the rewards were still dependent on clearing a certain number of levels - SCAM.

This is a fun-to-play version of the universal "match 3 of the same colour" game.  However, the levels of this game get RIDICULOUSLY HARD RIDICULOUSLY FAST.  After only 50 or so levels, every 3 or 4 levels are impossible to win unless you get to match certain very rare combinations, which means it can be shown mathematically that an optimally intelligent player will solve those levels only 1 out of 100 trials.  That means you can be stuck on a level for 2 weeks unless you pay the ransom. (You have to achieve a goal in a limited number of steps or lose a life; after 5 life losses,   you are blocked to play for 30 minutes unless you pay REAL MONEY for 5 more lives, or if you pay REAL MONEY for 5 more steps beyond the life loss.)  They should offer a one-off payment in exchange for unlimited lives for ever, but instead they want to suck your blood again and again and again. For ever.

I enjoyed playing this game but after making a few purchases last year (only special offers that randomly flash up) I have been charged in excess of 20 times since!! Daily this week, sometimes twice a day! Even though I have not requested to purchase anything and definitely have not received the 'handful of coins' I keep being invoiced and charged for! Frustrating.

The ad said 'I finally found a game that was exactly like the ads'. That ad lied twice. Not only is this game nothing like the ads, it is even less like the ads than the other 'not like the ads" games. But I'm still giving it three stars because, despite being NOTHING like the ads that say this game is 'just like the ads´, it's still a pretty fun game. Seriously though, you need to fix those ads, because those are not only lying, they are usually annoying as well. STOP! Decent game otherwise.

I have stubbornly persisted with this game. Some levels are impossibly hard on purpose (even if you are a smart player, unlike me), but will eventually concede to me after a few attempts without success. A pretty obvious ploy to get you to spend money for coins if you are impatient. A nice little storyline to keep you interested. I'm looking forward to finding out the ending.

Game started to freeze after new android update, but I am not sure if it is related. It is basic match 3 game with a little decoration on the side. It is bit frustrating, when you need to spend 4 stars on building a bookshelf, especially when it means passing 4 hard levels... This is not very well thought, or maybe it is, but only developers have fun. Boosters are way too expensive, also when there is "discount". Also I would suggest to chose other main character, he looks really creepy XD

Ok updating this review. The levels are clearly designed to be just hard enough to encourage microtransactions. The game reminds you constantly in a predatory way, during events, that you'll lose points and have your medals downgraded if you fail the level, unless you cash in. The levels are entertaining and fun when they don't try to monetize the difficulty spikes. Making your mansion prettier is the nice thing about the game. Conclusion: avoid spending on microtransactions!

I wrote review a few times, but it seems to dissappear every time. Dunno, if it's because developers can't handle criticism, but it happened to many time for coincidence. Anyway, I played for long time up to level 1400ish. Beginning is nice, but then game is getting more and more annoying. Sometimes it took days to pass one level and recently they added alarm clocks, in my opinion it crossed the line. I would say avoid it. Who needs extra frustration in life?

Money grabbing app. I have spent quite alot of money on the app, as £0.99 isn't alot to beat a level, however every level you need to get the extra lives. I know they say every level is designed to be beaten without boosters, but they don't say the odds it takes to get the right combos....could take upto 100 tries just to beat one level. I have done the wise thing to uninstall this game and not pump any more money into it. It's a fun game but beware it becomes addictive and you need to pump $in

I have recently noticed that in the past few months the amount of moves given to complete a game are almost half what they used to be. I'm currently stuck on a level that has 14 moves, a month ago it had 26!!! Seriously contemplating uninstalling as the enjoyment has been taken away and frustration has taken over! I know I'm not the only one who has noticed the changes! I used to purchase the gold ticket & occasionally the gold coins but I REFUSE to spend anymore!!! Please sort it out!!!

Fun game. I enjoy doing up the rooms. I wish there were more of the mini games. There are a few downfalls I find with this game such as some of the matching games to get the stars in order to get the tasks done are too hard as there are not enough moves. I also don't like the waste of time bits in between, the chatter between the characters and the pointless tasks which makes it take forever to get one room done, you shouldn't have to complete a game just to greet a guest or make a phone call.

I don't mind the game, it's a good way to pass the time I suppose, will say probably not as goad as reading a book, but hey, who does that any more? The one thing I don't like is that when you progress into the game, and you're renovating, some of the most meaningless tasks are requiring multiple stars, three to be precise. Sweeping the floor or closing the window should not be three stars.

This is not the game you see in the ads. It's just another match 3 game. The ad leads us to think it's a choice game to help the character through the obstacles, but there is NOTHING like that in the game. Same goes for Gardenscapes, Fishdom, etc. Seems like false advertising is what Playrix games are all about. Really disappointing. I wanted the game I saw in the ads.

The game itself is very nice, but I'm disappointed with the ads. They're basically advertising for a game that doesn't exist. Why this choice was even made is beyond me, as the actual game is very good while the one advertised looks pretty bad. This game used to have really good ads (animated) that actually were the reason I downloaded this game, but the current ads lure in people that are interested in puzzle games instead of connect 3.

I loved the game until I got to the level with some type of holes or seeds on the cookies and I couldn't complete the level because the pattern triggered my tripophobia. I tried to move on, I really did, but couldn't shake the trigger. Not writing this to be dramatic, just an FYI. Sadly, i deleted the app knowing I wouldn't be able to move passed any level with those patterns on the cookies. It really is a well put together app with a great storyline and lots of motivation to continue the game.

I like being able to decorate but becoming not fun anymore. Level 80 is nearly impossible to beat; how are you supposed to get 86 tiles of grass on 20 moves when everything is chained up, so you end up wasting more than half your moves before you get anywhere. All to feed the parrot. Not enough stars awarded, lives take too long to reload, and are too expensive to buy back along with the boosters, not enough moves for the puzzles and they're always changing numerous times for a level.

First of all, please fix the optional review. Why ask questions if it doesn't even help & make sense at all. For the main review, let's start with the FALSE ADVERTISING. It's effective which made me play this but I hope you consider the law or at least add a mini game feature similar to it (to make the game unique). Good thing about the game was its story & the customization of the home. The rest was the same as any other puzzle matching game you can see. Overall it's fun but disappointing.

I was able to restart the game from 0, and with lots of events that appeared I was able to get to level 44. But playing "Restaurant Revival" (up to level 60) I could understand why playing "Homescapes" I got stressed so easily: because it is purposely made for you to waste money. If you can't beat levels without wasting money, boosters and power ups, it will appear a time where you need to buy them. It is not enjoyful to play like that.

The advertising of this game is flipping misleading. When I downloaded the game it appeared to be a three-in-a-row game, not that kind of solving puzzles shown in the ad. However, I was playing it for a while until the game lost its charm and started enforcing me to buy some perks for hell of amount of real money. Deleted it in the end. P. S. If there were a chance to put minus zillion, I would have put this mark without any second thoughts.

Ok so this game is a cashgrab. Sorry but most level are rather easy and fun and will only require that you play a a few times to clear them. But once every five level they throw a "hard". Not a real hard just that there only 2 sequence of moves to beat it... So if you dont mind spending a whole day on it you won't have to spend anything on it. And ads that you can watch give you 35 to 46 gold, the cheapest power up is 900 gold and you can watch about 4 ads a day maximum.

It started like a nice game, but honestly right now, you guys are making me lose interest for the game. The timing is to short, levels are to hard and to many challenges at the same time in one game. It's not fun anymore! Game are purpose to help you relax not create stress! I remember in the past, no week passed by with me play but not I chose not to remember the game.

Misleading ads. I was expecting the game to be just like its ads. Turns out it is more like a combination of Candy Crush and a bit of The Sims. Still entertaining to play, at least until I reached level 60, in which it became impossible for me to proceed further without spending real money, buying coins to get additional moves and also power ups to make it easier to reach the goal. The coins is priced at MYR4.99 per 1000 coins (900 coins for additional 5 moves). No option to get reward by ads.

I've been playing this game religiously for quite a while now and I think with a few tweaks it could be even better, with less petty frustrations. The skip option after completing a level is a great idea, wastes too much time (of which we all have a lack of already). I also feel it is unfair to just throw unlimited lives at us without notice. Although a half hour is great, a 2hr bonus is more often than not wasted. I always seem to get them when I dont have the time to use them or I'm super sleepy. Hence they're wasted and they truly come in handy on those harder levels. Maybe a pause when gameplay is not active? Or some kind of pop up to let you know if you win you'll be granted unlimited lives for x amount of time. This way, us avid players, will get the most of out our free time. This game is great. It does exactly what it's supposed to, kill time and entertain with cute little twists along the way. Its not glitchy and it's lovely to look at. I like that you can buy lives and upgrades. Although some levels are difficult, as others have mentioned, they're not impossible (Except the random cat levels. I still haven't mastered ONE of those) Persistence pays off. Even more so with unlimited lives. Hint hint.

The ad I saw about this game was so captivating, like wow I get to pick tools and fix the house myself, after using eternity and plenty data to download it, it was nothing promised. Just a puzzle I get to play and things are done, even things that are unnecessary. Some levels are rather too difficult. Please make the game what you showed to us in the ad. I don't like it.

I actually really enjoy the game but there's only so many times I will play the same, practically impossible to solve without spending real money on boosts etc level, over and over and over and damn well over until I think...why am I playing this? It's supposed to be fun and relaxing. Not so frustrating I swear at Austin and want to throw him against the wall! Then I don't play for a few days and when I do finally come back to it...by some miracle I solve the level first go..hmm.

I like this better than Gardenscapes. The boosters are better. The amount of pop-ups for extra things in the game are annoying. You give free hearts for so many minutes but too much of that time is wasted exiting pop-ups so you can actually play the game. I also get frustrated at the continual amount of lengthy updates. By the time it's updated, I'm tired of waiting and give up on playing. Sometimes I go in to play and see there's ANOTHER update so I just exit and play a different game.

Reduced my rating from 3 to 1 ... since the last update can't cancel a game once you've started so stuck playing through all the moves when you know it's going to be a complete waste of time. game also now becomes completely unresponsive at times and need to close and reopen to get it to work again. More near impossible levels with too few moves to try and force you to buy power ups. Can be stuck for days before you miraculously get 'lucky' and clear the level with easy combos. Money grabbing bs

I used to enjoy playing Homescapes but there are multiple factors that are deterring me to continue playing. 1) Difficult to clear levels with low amount of moves, this has been drastically cut; 2) The game has become a cash grab/play to win; 3) They have increased the price overtime for buying coins; 4) Asking teammates for SOS timer is extremely long. I can keep going on but I think the developers should take in and listen to the feedback from players. Overall, it's been disappointing.

It's a great game, pretty fun; but it has some issues. For starters, I really hope that the game would be advertised for what it really was which isn't a puzzle game. Another problem is that it could take like 3 or 4 stars to do something as simple as place a table or so, also 5 extra moves costing 900 gold coins is way too much. The levels, no matter the hardness, reward only 1 star. I think the harder the level, the more stars should be rewarded. It also takes way too long to generate one life

best game, has NO ADS. though I won't mind a optional ad in return for a few extra moves (even just 2) has I am on 1 thousand & 7 hundred & something, so I have some very difficult levels, so any coins I earn soon go & can't afford to keep buying coins and number of times I only needed another 1/2 moves to finish it, but don't have the coins to buy the extra moves, so gaining a extra 2/3 in exchange for watching ad would be welcome, has don't mind ads if optional & I get a reward.

I found the game through an ad which showed that you have to choose between tools to repair the kitchen. The game is completely diffrent and has nothing to do with the ad, but I still played it. It's quite addicting actually. But for someone who just wants to play, the storyline gets annoying - especially the parts you can't skip. Now, I have a problem. My phone shut down when I was playing level 285 (???) and the game resetet itself. I'd have to start over. No thank you, I am uninstalling it.

Would've been a great puzzle game if only the developers didn't think too much about earning money out of this game. Most of the levels (even the regular ones and not the "hard" ones) are quite difficult as they give fewer chances of swaps. I noticed that you actually have to repeat a certain level over and over again until you can finally progress which is quite frustrating, unless you're ready to buy more swaps (which I did a few times using my google play rewards). I'm sorry, it's a failure.

I used to love this game and the story, discovering new levels and opening new rooms. Great graphics and fun levels. But after the update around level 1000 it just hasn't worked very well. I will pass a level or use game coins for extra moves and it cuts out completely. When I go back in my coins have been used and I'm still stuck on the same level without the extra moves I brought. Super frustrating! I ended up stopping playing as I don't want to use real money and have this happen.

It's nothing like the ads. I was under the impression that it's a game where you have to fix rooms by choosing objects. Instead it's another version of Candy Crush, and it gets difficult pretty quickly, with levels becoming almost impossible to complete without spending real money. I like the whole designing element , but it's difficult to progress as stars are needed to complete actions, but you can only get them through completing the levels. Would not recommend.

I think some of the reviews are too critical. If a game isn't challenging, it becomes boring and when it's too easy to earn coins and buy lives or boosters, the items seem to lose value. Besides, there's always gifts when completing daily tasks. The game comes off easy at first then the levels gradually become difficult yet exciting. I think I'm addicted to this gane because of how challenging it is. By the way, the graphic is perfect for a game of this size. I love it😊😊

The game, despite the false advertising is nice. Art is beautiful, the characters are lovable and the puzzles are fun. BUT , power ups don't do much, so I wouldn't pay for them even if I had that much to spare, some levels are made impassable without buying extra moves. Honestly, I'd pay a full price for this game but micro transactions are abusive.

FALSE ADVERTISEMENTS. I installed the game for, what's shown on advertisements as "using the right tools to fix the house" puzzle. I know that match 3, was part of the game play, but I was hoping for the puzzle mini games. Turns out, after 100 or so levels, there's still no mini game. Apart from that, it is a game with interaction(chosing furniture to decorate) and a cute storyline. It keeps the game fun, hence 4 stars.

I've played this game for a while now, on and off. It's more about gardening as the previous one than doing the house up. It's also really obvious about letting you get a couple of moves away from completing a level before busting out to encourage you to spend ££. I can spend ages on one level until the game suddenly decides I can move forward or I've amassed 900 coins for a few extra moves. Shame as it started out fun.

I really want to like this game, as the concept is fun. However, it doesn't take long until you have to spend days trying to pass a single level, sometimes even while using boosters. The game has quickly gone from fun/challenging to just being frustrating. On top of that, too little of the game is spent actually renovating. While I understand that they have to drag the game out, it's incredibly annoying to struggle to pass a level, only to have those stars go to some pointless action like calling someone or starting a new day. I love the PC Playrix games, but sadly this looks like a pass for me.

It's a good game, no doubt but it gets so stressful. Why don't you guys include an option for friends to send gifts like boosters and all? It would make playing a tad easier and more fun. And also, the cake competition, there should be an option to maybe pause or choose when we want the infinity lives. We can't continuously sit for more than 6 hours playing, that's just ridiculous.

I love the game (tile matching), but it's very addictive. Don't see the purpose of the mini games... You can watch adds for extra credit but otherwise ads will not bother your gameplay. LE: all ads have been removed, it's nice that there are a lot of events and team competitions to keep things interesting. Downside is that, at high levels (7000+) some levels seem to be repeating but still great game :)

So far so good. I love the game. It's super engaging & fun to play. Plus I love the different things you can do with your wins when playing the game and going up the levels. I actually also like the conversations of the characters too. Update (months later): The game eventually becomes too difficult & impossible to win or move levels and the only way to go up is to buy more coins or something. So disappointing- forcing players to spend money and/or download apps. Also the Ads just got too much.

The game is NOT as advertised. It is a candy crush style game, you get stars for completing levels which are then used to get tasks done but they are done for you, you don't get to "fix" anything! Also once you've levelled up a few times,the levels become impossible to complete because there are far too few moves for what you need to collect. I know it's no fun if it's too easy but at least make the levels possible! I refuse to buy coins and boosters, games should be playable without real money!

this game is really good, but there could be improvements. for example, giving the player a keyboard so they can talk back to Austin, or giving the player an avitar to control and move. another main one is to give the player more freedom and advantages, otherwise, it becomes boring and stressful. there are a few others, but i won't go into detail too much. apart from that, this game is fun and addictive. ENJOY!!!!!!!!!!!

This app is far from "free" if you want to move to higher levels. Some of the levels are ridiculous to try to get past so if you don't have boosters you can be stuck for days... not my idea of fun. Not to mention you need stars to do the renovations however many of the stars earned are wasted on trivial things, calling someone, receiving a package, opening a package, assembling the item, fixing the object in the package because they break the object, fixing up a car... too many to list. Argh!

First, I installed it because of false advertising. I think it's a shame that this company needs to resort to it. Why not make the game in the ad instead? It would be more interesting. Second, this is a dull, repetitive connect-the-bubbles game. Some levels are impossible to complete without special items. There is very little actual building. Third, this morning, after playing for months, the game reset itself back to level one. So, it's uninstalled after this, and it's one less waste of time.

Not as advertised. The ads for fixing problems like putting out a fire looked interesting. I downloaded because I want a new style of puzzle game to play. This is nothing like that. It's a Candy Crush type matching game and the levels get really difficult, really fast. The graphics are great but the progress is interminably slow without spending significant real cash. Misleading con. Unimpressed. Will be uninstalling.

Very entertaining game. Some levels are very challenging and almost impossible to pass without boosters. I constantly ran out of lives as I didn't want to spend my boosters all at once. Wish that to continue when out of moves wouldn't cost as much as it did. The coins I accumulate over 20 levels are just enough to continue twice. Other than that, game is fine.

this game is like Candy crush, only much better. yes, you have to clear puzzles with power ups and extra moves etc. but you get rewarded with stars after every successful puzzle board. these can then be used to upgrade your home. you can choose between different upgrades to upgrade to your taste, but can also change your mind at any time. yes, you can spend money but you don't really need to. a classic timewaster, but with enough interest to keep you playing. well done.

Started off as a great game. Its great having the levels give stars to complete tasks. However its got to a point now where they have followed the style of candy crush where the levels get increasingly impossible and you have to buy things to progress. Really disappointing, especially when the whole point of the game is to do renovations which you can't do without winning levels.

Fun game, thousands of levels. I especially like that you can play offline. When you run out of lives, you can wait for more, or if you've joined a team, you can ask teammates for lives. It's difficult to achieve the grand prize chest during special events, requires a lot of game play. Aside from playing the levels, there are silly little mini games, and a whole storyline of renovating a home. You're given a choice (out of 3) on decoration options. I hope they continue making new levels.

The game itself is fun and challenging but i have 2 major issues with it. 1. Level difficulties. It gets to the point where you're forced to spend to actually win. 2. MISLEADING ADVERTISING. The ads only ever show the mini games which is a VERY small percentage of the full game. This wasn't the case as ads prior to the mini games were actually quite accurate to the gameplay. unless you pay attention to the screen shots, you won't realize what you're getting into.

Could be absolutely fantastic. I love decorating and furnishing the house etc, but the levels can be frustratingly difficult (obviously to coerce you into using power ups), and then you're forced to spend so many stars on mundane activities like "feed the parrot" to advance - which is annoying when you've taken so long just to get past the level in the first place.

A mostly fun game! It has been fun and challenging! I know there are people on higher levels than I am, but when a level takes weeks to pass, it ain't fun no more! Yes you can pass each level, but this is where I draw the line. 3 weeks on one level, 4 days on level 1399, this is where I say goodbye and uninstall the game. Silly enough to pick the gam up at Christmas. Never doing it again. Fun has gone out. Can't stand these hard and superhard levels anymore.

Originally gave this 5 stars, then I got to a level which was impossible to complete in the number of turns given. Basically it's a set-up to make you pay for more turns. That, coupled with misleading advertising, made me delete the app altogether. The thing is, I would have happily made a one off payment to buy this as overall it's a good concept and graphics/gameplay/ etc are good, but the makers trying to mislead customers and underhandedly get more and more money out of us has put me off.

A very boring game. Having to complete 2 difficult levels just to take a TV out of its box. Really? Absolutely nothing resembling the game in the ads it saturates other games with. Totally misleading. And to top it off, a main character who starts calling me his best friend after a few levels. A bit weird for me, thanks. Uninstalling after precisely one day.

Enjoyable game. Note to developers: tiles don't react to half the explosions when you have a few things going on at the same time. Meaning if your cat statue, for example, received 3 explosions from one move, it may react to only one of them most of the time in stead of being completely destroyed needing 3 explosions. A second point is that the bonuses you accumulate, do not count towards the end cash

Homescapes as a game is fantastic! It's levels and stories are enjoyable but it lacks a little bit of the freedom aspect to do what you want, which although it's addictable, can make it a little tiresome! Also, the pictures are a little deceptive as the levels you have to complete are not the main focus. However, overall, the game is enjoyable and I enjoy listening to the story and *cleaning up*.

This game is very nice and very addicting. It always gets me excited whenever I unlock a new room. Although there are some parts which needs improvement. For example: There are levels that aren't labeled as hard when it really is, the party room decorations do not compliment each other (some decorations don't match with one another), and you cannot finish some levels due to the very limited amount of moves. But overall, I like it and I wish it could add more rooms to it. hehe

This is a totally different game than advertised. It looked to be a problem solving game, with different tools to fix different disasters, in the right order. Instead, it's a home reno game combined with a candy crush style game. Despite the false advertising, I did enjoy the game for a while, but the levels have now become impossibly difficult. i have to spend days & days on the same level if i don't want to spend money to progress. it'ts no longer enjoyable - more like a source of stress.

This game is good and the side mini game has potential but the levels are quite hard after a certain point as you have to rely on a lot of luck if you have ran out of boosters. I think there should be easy medium hard choice maybe, and those on harder levels get more stars per completed level. I'm uninstalling this game as I have tried way too long to get past a level, which is a shame because I'm enjoying the other aspects of the game. Thank you for your hard work in this game. :-)

I enjoy the game & find it entertaining but, have some complaints. Very often, always with just a few moves left, when moving a power-up to a crucial spot, it goes in the opposite direction which ruins any chance of winning. It's like the game is cheating. Also, it is most annoying to get an unlimited lives bonus & then not be able to use all of it, or at all. We should at least be able to start it when it's convenient. I got 1 for 6 hours just as i was going to bed, so couldn't use any of it.

Changing the rating from 5 stars to 3. This game is outstanding. The power-ups are great and I use them all the time. The levels are challenging and I like that. I am on level 1600 and what I don't like is the fact that now there are "hard-level" after every normal level. Its tough to complete hard level and I would want few normal levels to enjoy the game before getting to another hard level.

Developers, you are absolutely killing us with the in game pop ups for events. At the beginning of the event, sure - pop up and let us know it's on the go but EVERY time we log in?? Every time we beat a level and pass another player?? It wastes precious booster timers, on top of being incredibly annoying. Especially when there is more than one event going on! There's no need, we can check our own progress by tapping the icon on the main screen if we want to be competitive. Make it stop, please.

The idea of the game is nice, but the mini games are too difficult (even the first ones). You have a few easy ones to keep you hooked up and then many impossible ones where the only way to pass is to use boosters as there's clearly too few moves available for the task. Obviously the boosters are not easy to get and the reward after winning a game is just one star and a few coins (but they require 900 for 5 extra moves). Also I'm now wasting time to name and feed a cat when it should be about renovating a house! Maybe the cat can be a side quest, not a mandatory one to continue the game!

The game is amazing in everything, except its progress. It is very very slow, amd you have to spent way too much time doing useless errands, especially in the garden part, i almost deleted the game because of its slow progress. Other than that, everything else is just great, from graphics to game play, all is amazing.

I'm at around level 8500. Most of the easy levels are way too hard and those that are supposed to ver very hard way too easy. For the one that gives you 50, 10 moves are impossible unless you can buy extra moves. Also it's getting very annoying that I play 1 day for stars and then 5 days for when you guys do updates and can't earn any stars. I have been playing it for over 4 years now, but this is just starting to get very annoying. Other than that the game is great.

I am on level 244 and it is next to impossible to complete. The levels are becoming way to hard, I've used about half my boosters and still cant get through it. Plus I love the addition of the new "dream puzzles" but there should be more of them. Something to look forward too especially after it takes so much effort to get through the main puzzles.

This game has it's moments but you very rarely play the levels shown in the adverts which is what I downloaded it for. To begin with you play about 3-4 of the games matching items levels, you'll get an escape level come up which are the most entertaining parts of this game. Eventually you don't see them anymore. I uninstalled it as it's morphed into a pay to win as I've gone on. Needless to say I haven't wasted any money on this and advise anyone not to. Only winner's here are the developers.

While the animation is wonderfully done and the concept is good, I find it incredibly frustrating and annoying that it is near impossible to win or play this game without spending money. Either on coins, lifes or more turns in the actual gameplay. The fact that you can barely play and you definitely can't win, without spending actual money, is a huge setback for me. I was hoping this was going to be a fun, relatively cheap game and was thoroughly disappointed.

The game is great in asthetics and over all gameplay. Money is required to move ahead else it is frustrating. You don't have options to acquire coins from watching ads which makes it impossible to move ahead if you don't have money. Additional moves are very expensive both in actual money and in-game coins. Sometimes levels are deliberate and it is only by-chance that you can pass a level. All of their games-scapes are similar in some way and form. Else, they are a great story and game.

The ads are very misleading! I was hoping for more of what your ads showed but because I like match up games it ended up being a fun and addictive. Now it's just frustrating as hell, I play games like this to relax not to be aggravated. I am not very far into the game because I literally cant get anywhere without spending real money to advance. Not something I would recommend to anyone. 50-100 coins for completing a level what a joke, especially when everything you need to advance is MUCH more!

It's a match the symbols game where you earn stars so you can buy items to redecorate the house. It looks good but it really isn't as advertised (hence the low rating). If you like "match the shapes to make them disappear in various combinations to complete the level" type games then go for it as it's quite good. If you're after the game they advertise in the clickbait then don't bother.

I have had to review my rating and downgrade it to a 1. I lost all my many years progress and the effort to get assistance was futile. I have had to start from level 1 when I was already heading for level 6000. This is my previous review👉🏾Been playing for years. Good fun and out of the box creativity upgrades. I'm disappointed!

I like playing this game. Most of the levels are interesting to play and I like the story behind the levels. Also developers don't look too greedy. You can get bonuses from regular events, some times you get decent discounts to buy bonuses for real money, but you can beat any level without bonuses if you persistent and a little bit lucky. Also I would hope developers will change the speed of main story progress. It is getting annoying when you have to beat 3-4 levels to renovate 1 little item.

Really is a fun game. But the tasks become too expensive, thus the storyline progression becomes extremely slow. This will be the only reason for me to stop playing the game. I don't mind spending SOME money, but it really is frustrating to enjoy a game that becomes increasingly expensive to progress. It really spoils the fun when you are stuck on a level for 5 days. Please, for the love of the game, listen to people's suggestions. The hard levels are already difficult, adding a super hard is just ridiculous. It's not a game if you make it that difficult.

At first, the game was enjoyable. Beating levels, decorating house, and enjoyed story. The longer you play, the duller the story gets and the levels become almost impossible to beat unless you purchase more coins to continue playing. I've been playing this for a few years and I'm really disappointed. And also, DON'T TRUST THE ADVERTISING VIDEOS! All fake; this game is not what is advertised. They tried to insert the gamemode of moving bars and getting past obstacles, but failed miserably.

It's a nice game but some levels are mis-graded, they're impossible to get through without boosters. You have to attempt again and again until the computer gives you a winning combination of where the tiles fall. It's a gem drop kind of thing. Some easy levels are hard, some hard ones can be easy. It doesn't get plagued with ads, but it's frustrating sometimes. It's there to make money from you, like a lot of games these days.

Reasons for my low rating: 1) False advertising. I am at level 165 and I still haven't met the feature for which I downloaded the game. 2) Too difficult.It gets very frustrating trying to pass a level for 40-50 times by chance, when there is ahead of you another 2000 levels, and having no other way to pass the level. At least generating a few coins in every play could partly solve that.

I don't know why are people leaving a review saying levels are hard to pass. This is a challenging game, you don't need to buy anything if you play to win. Eventually you will pass. I was stuck on a level for 3 days, multiple times, it's just makes the game more interesting, not annoying, it's annoying if you pass every level after 1-2-3 attempts. I'm on level 3000 and have NEVER purchased anything. Play and have fun, don't play to waste time.

It's fun at first and then you quickly realise that's how they try to suck you in and then progressively make the levels so hard that you have no choice but to buy coins to complete them. I've played certain levels at least 10 times to see if luck can change but no, it's literally impossible to beat the level unless you buy coins to get more moves in order to complete it. It's very demotivational actually and I wish I could refund the money that I have already spent because it's not fun anymore

Just got to level 101 and will be deleting it again. I've downloaded this game multiple times because of it's enticing advertising. However, the game has nothing to do with it. The fun puzzles shown in ads are a recent addition, and I've only seen about 5 for 100 levels. Levels take multiple attempts and the 5 "lives" restrict your gameplay. You can't play whenever you want, instead only when your "lives" refill. Each "life" takes 30min to refill. Horrible game, I don't recommend it.

I really enjoy this game but the higher up the levels you get it becomes more obvious that the game developers have the code set up for you to fail. There are dozens of times I've matched 4,or a square of 4 etc and it's not registered a paper plane, or other special piece. I see new pieces falling down and matching to make a special piece but again, I'm not awarded the special piece. These levels don't necessarily get more difficult, they become more rigged against the player!

Starts great but then ruined. The concept is really cute and you gain stars to complete the tasks by solving the puzzles. The puzzles became increasingly hard which is fun, but not when they become impossible and the only option is to purchase boosters. Also in the adverts it shows more of the "dude is trapped help him out" scenarios but I think after 3 weeks of playing on off, I only did 3? Had to delete at level 80 as couldn't get through without having to purchase.

Thank you for adding more power-ups as rewards! I feel like the game has been a bit "glitchy" lately.... The airplanes are hitting random, unhelpful targets and when connecting 4 pieces, many times, I have not gotten the arrows. Better rating if this was fixed. It would be cool if you could actually choose where the arrow landed!

Game mode is easy (matching game). It's different from the ad that made me download this game, from the ad I thought this was a running and puzzle solving game, but the real game isn't that, also in some level, this game is deliberately making it almost impossible for you to pass, at some level I even tried using 3 knids of boosters and still needs to buy 5 more moves to pass. I'd like to agree with some other user's comment, this game requires much more luck that your skill.

In general it's a fun game, but the "hard" and "super hard" levels border on "impossible". Using up all lives repeatedly on the same level for several days in a row without being able to make any progress on the house is frustrating and takes the fun out of playing it. You could add a "skip this level" option in exchange for watching an ad for example. That would save a lot of people a lot of frustration and make the game more enjoyable. Just please don't make it cost coins!

The game are enjoyable, fun and pretty addicting. As you get higher up in levels the game, seems designed to make you spend money to complete levels. The game is fun until it's pretty, impossible to move forward. I think the developers make the puzzle easier to solve after doing the same puzzle about 30 times. They must use of some sort of All.

All the ads were super misleading.. I was expecting a game where I chose the things to save the guy from dying or something, but it was a simple match the three same symbols puzzle with some home renovation. It wasn't what I was looking for, but I guess if you're looking for a puzzle/simple decorating game, this is it. (But I seriously don't get the misleading ads...)

I used to play this often. The concept is great. The butler is a good character and the story is well written. But its nearly impossible to proceed at some points. Either you spend money to get some boosters, which doesn't guarantee your success, or you spend days or weeks on the same level getting frustrated. If this was more like their other game Township, where you could just build and not worry about the Candy Crush ripoff puzzles, it would be so much better.

The game is fun, I enjoy playing it here and there. The reason I dont play it more is because there is just too much to do in each room to unlock the next.
